11 月 11 日消息，英伟达发布公告，宣布已聘请美国前联邦检察官金正贤（Joon H. Kim）及其所在的律师事务所 Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz，负责开展一项全面、独立的调查。

此前，英伟达董事会表示，鉴于近期有关公司创始人兼 CEO 黄仁勋可能成为外国情报机构目标的报道，董事会决定启动独立调查。董事会将成立由独立董事组成的委员会，并在外部独立法律顾问协助下监督调查。

英伟达董事会此前还表示，目前没有理由认为美国国家安全或英伟达的商业机密已经遭到泄露，但调查将审查所有可获得的信息。黄仁勋支持此次调查，并承诺配合相关工作。董事会同时表示，对黄仁勋及其领导团队保持信心。（来源：凤凰网科技）

Anthropic 已正式启动首次公开募股（IPO）的投资者路演。公司计划发行 8.25 亿股股票，每股发行价区间为 70 至 78 美元，最高募资规模可达 643.5 亿美元。若按区间上限定价，其完全稀释估值将接近 1.4 万亿美元，这将是人工智能行业迄今规模最大的上市交易之一。

根据公司披露的招股文件，本次发行包括公司新发行的 8.01351354 亿股，以及现有股东出售的 2364.8646 万股。公司不会从老股出售中获得任何收益。同时，承销商还获得一项为期 30 天的选择权，可额外认购 1.2375 亿股。

除公开募股外，Anthropic 还宣布多家科技巨头将通过单独的私募配售方式合计投资 260 亿美元。其中，Google 与英伟达各出资 100 亿美元，领投本轮；AMD 将投入 25 亿美元；微软、博通和美光各投资 10 亿美元；台积电伙伴公司则追加 5 亿美元。按每股 74 美元的中间价计算，IPO 与私募配售合计将为公司带来约 846 亿美元的净募资额。

Anthropic 向美国证券交易委员会提交的更新文件还披露了其经营数据。2026 年前九个月，公司实现营收 332 亿美元，而去年同期仅为 25 亿美元，增速极为惊人。同期净亏损为 1040 亿美元，其中 943 亿美元来自可转换债券及其他金融工具的公允价值变动，属于非经营性账面影响；该期间的经营亏损实际为 13 亿美元。

另外，根据招股书，Anthropic 的七名联合创始人将在 IPO 中合计出售价值 17.5 亿美元的股票。按 IPO 发行价区间中点计算，每位联合创始人拟出售价值约 2.5 亿美元的股票。据亿万富翁指数，按这一估值计算，每人的净资产将达到约 180 亿美元。（来源：cnbeta）

11 月 10 日，阿里巴巴公告称，拟分拆全资子公司平头哥（上海）技术股份有限公司赴香港联交所主板独立上市。香港联交所已确认阿里巴巴可进行此次分拆，平头哥已于 2026 年 9 月 11 日以保密形式向港交所递交上市申请（A1 表格）。此次分拆拟通过全球发售 H 股进行，包括香港公开发售及向机构和专业投资者配售。

分拆完成后，平头哥预计仍将为阿里巴巴子公司。目前，全球发售规模、架构及阿里巴巴持股比例的调整幅度尚未确定。此次分拆仍需获得港交所上市委员会批准及完成中国证监会备案等程序。（来源：凤凰网）

11 月 11 日消息，Odessia 创始人弗朗西斯 · 戴维森（Francis Davidson）今天宣布，OpenAI 已收购 AI 旅行智能体公司 Odessia，他本人也已经加入 OpenAI，帮助这家 AI 初创公司探索旅游业务发展方向。

据悉，Odessia 成立仅一年，就拿到了红杉资本领投的 600 万美元种子前融资，并在大约 5 个月前推出了 AI 旅游智能体服务，帮助早期用户规划价值数百万美元的旅行行程。

不过，OpenAI 尚未公布任何旅游领域的新产品或计划。目前该公司的同领域合作伙伴有 Booking.com 缤客、Expedia 和 KAYAK。对于未来是否会推出旅游相关产品，OpenAI 发言人没有透露更多信息，仅表示旅游是用户经常向 ChatGPT 咨询的话题之一。（来源：IT 之家）

当地时间 11 月 10 日，谷歌宣布正式开放 Gemini 4 Carbon 模型，面向开发者、企业、科研人员和消费者提供服务。

谷歌高级副总裁、DeepMind 首席 AI 架构师 Koray Kavukcuoglu 介绍称，该模型是谷歌目前能力最强的推理模型，重点面向复杂软件工程、多步骤智能体任务、科学研究和网络安全等场景。

Gemini 4 Carbon 于 10 月 28 日首次公布，此前通过 Fairwind Program（网络安全合作计划）向部分网络安全防御人员开放。此次则进一步扩大使用范围。

谷歌称，相较于同期推出的 Gemini 4 Argon，Carbon 能够在复杂任务中投入更多推理 Token，进行假设探索、结果验证和边缘情况检查，更适合多步骤编码、复杂调试以及开放式科学研究。

在开发者工具方面，Gemini 4 Carbon 已通过 Gemini API 和 Google AI Studio 向付费开发者开放，同时面向企业客户提供服务。模型也正在向 Google AI Ultra 订阅用户逐步开放，覆盖 Google Antigravity、Gemini 应用和 Google 搜索中的 AI 模式。

谷歌此次将 Gemini 4 Carbon 定位为面向长周期复杂任务的高推理模型，与侧重多数日常软件工程和知识工作场景的 Gemini 4 Argon 形成分工。（来源：网易）

索尼互动娱乐宣布，将从 12 月 10 日起停止向 PC 用户提供 PlayStation Plus 应用。该应用面向符合资格的 PlayStation Plus Premium 会员，但实际使用人数不足合资格会员的 0.4%。

索尼互动娱乐内容采购与运营高级总监 Adam Michel 表示，公司会定期审视现有服务，将资源集中于会员更加重视的高质量体验，此次调整也是基于这一原则。

此次关停也引发了外界对索尼 PC 业务策略的讨论。彭博社此前披露，PlayStation 工作室业务集团负责人 Hermen Hulst 曾向员工表示，索尼的大型叙事驱动游戏今后不会继续登陆 PC，而会转为 PlayStation 主机独占。前索尼互动娱乐全球工作室负责人吉田修平也曾认为，公司可能重新强调平台业务。（来源：3DMGame）

11 月 11 日消息，拼多多新版《送货上门服务条款》已于 10 月 28 日公示，并将于 11 月 13 日正式生效，昨天突然在微博等平台登上热搜。

根据新规，针对带有专属标识的订单，商家若违背上门承诺将未履约每单赔付 10 元，且诱导放代收点等行为均被明确界定为违约。

新规的核心变化不仅在于 10 元 / 单的赔付金额，更在于将「送货上门」从一项模糊的服务描述，变成了附带举证责任转移与经营性处罚的可追责条款。

适用范围有明确边界：新规只约束商品页面带有「送货上门」绿色标识的订单，没有该标识的包裹仍按原有方式配送。商家在服务模板中自行勾选支持上门的区域，才构成承诺；未勾选的区域不受此条款约束。

对商家而言，更重的后果来自配套的经营性处罚：违规记录可能触发商品降权、屏蔽、下架、禁售、提高保证金、限制提现，情节严重的可终止合作。（来源：搜狐网）

11 月 11 日消息，Anthropic 开始推出 Claude Whiteboards（白板）、Claude Sheets（表格）和 Claude Data（原 Claude Dashboards），把 AI 助手从「聊天问答」进一步推向团队协作工作台，用户可以在白板上梳理计划、在表格中搭建追踪器，并把业务数据变成可共享的仪表盘、数据故事或解说视频。

三项产品面向所有付费计划提供，支持网页端、桌面端和移动端；其中白板应用 Whiteboards 与表格 Sheets 目前处于测试阶段，Claude Data 则已正式上线。

官方希望让 Claude 从生成文字、代码或文档，转向直接参与团队的日常协作。Claude Whiteboards 方面，用户可以口头描述一个模糊计划，Claude 会将其整理为包含时间线、负责人和日期的白板，团队成员则可实时在同一块白板上补充想法。会议复盘时，Claude 还能将零散讨论按主题归类，并起草每个人的行动项。（来源：新浪）

11 月 10 日消息，谷歌推出迄今为止能力最强的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）机器人模型 Gemini Robotics 2.5，大幅提升机器人可学习的技能广度与学习速度。

该模型增强了机器人的灵巧度、可靠性与安全性，助力机器人走出实验室，进入更非结构化的真实环境，协助人类完成更多类型的任务。

真实环境非结构化且不可预测，机器人必须同时具备高精度与高可靠性来处理日常物体。借助 Gemini Robotics 2.5，谷歌拓展了模型在任务广度、性能与复杂度上的能力，测试任务达 200 项，例如用夹子分发食物、给礼品盒系蝴蝶结、移液操作液体等。

评估显示，该模型在任务精度、鲁棒性与速度上均有显著提升：相较于此前基线，Gemini Robotics 2.5 按任务类型不同，成功率高出 30% 至 100%，任务完成速度快 20% 至 30%。

谷歌与 Apptronik、奔驰合作，在匈牙利凯奇凯梅特、德国辛德尔芬根的在用汽车生产线上，部署 Apollo 2 人形机器人测试 Gemini Robotics 2.5。

在此次概念验证中，Apollo 2 自主完成汽车物料拣配工作：这是一项重复性强、体力消耗大的任务，需要将散料箱中的单个零部件，按照线上每台车辆的精确需求顺序，分拣到规整托盘内。

谷歌同时在推进长周期智能体任务的安全能力：Gemini 4 Argon 在智能体机器人评估中处于领先水平，评估维度包括危险任务拒绝、不确定性消解、近距离人机协作。

Argon 可基于真实相机场景生成数千个多样化的模拟练习片段，构建高保真数字孪生。结合真实训练演示数据，机器人能更快泛化适配全新场景与物体。

Argon 还可帮助研究人员从视频片段中推演任务失败原因，在仿真环境与真实机器人上同步测试最优改进方案。（来源：cnbeta）

11 月 11 日消息，技嘉推出 AI TOP AERO 迷你主机，采用英伟达 RTX Spark 平台。这款产品拥有 Blackwell 架构 GPU、最高 128GB 统一内存和紧凑型设计，将端侧 AI 开发、内容创作和游戏体验带入个人工作空间。

据介绍，这款迷你主机搭载英伟达 RTX Spark N1X 超级芯片，整合 20 核 Grace CPU 和 Blackwell 架构的 RTX GPU，最高可选 128GB LPDDR5X 统一内存，以及 4TB PCIe Gen 5 SSD，为端侧 AI 模型和 AI 应用程序提供充足计算资源。（来源：快科技）

11 月 11 日消息，科技媒体 MacRumors 昨日（11 月 10 日）发布博文，梳理、验证和汇总多条供应链消息和可靠信源爆料，认为苹果为庆祝 iPhone 问世 20 周年，会在 2027 年 9 月推出 20 周年版 iPhone（上市后可能名为 iPhone 20 Pro），有望迎来外观、屏幕、交互、影像与芯片等全方位升级。

外观方面，这款旗舰 iPhone 20 Pro 将成为自 2017 年 iPhone X 以来最彻底的一次设计革新，机身正面或呈现为一块几乎无边界、四边弯曲的玻璃，金属边框在正常使用时被隐藏，视觉上更接近「一整块玻璃」。

面板方面，苹果公司预估推迟部署 CoE 和 LTPO+ 两项显示技术，不过依然会采用无边四曲面弯折屏幕方案。

CoE 是 Color Filter on Encapsulation 的缩写，直译为封装彩色滤光片，指将显示屏所需的彩色滤光结构整合至封装层附近或面板内部，可减少部分传统光学结构占用的空间。

交互方面，消息称苹果正在测试无实体位移的固态按键，侧边键、音量键、操作按钮及相机控制键或均改由压力感应与触觉马达反馈实现；按键位置保留，但不再有传统机械行程，机身开孔减少后，有望进一步提升密封性与一体感。

固态按键（Solid-state button）是一种没有机械活动部件、靠传感器识别按压的按键。它看起来可能仍是一个按键区域，但按下去时并不会真的「沉下去」，而是由压力 / 触摸传感器识别动作，再由线性马达模拟出类似实体按键的震动和「咔哒」反馈。

屏幕方面，苹果据称在测试屏下 Face ID 和前置摄像头，希望取消正面可见开孔；不过屏下光学方案能否在 2027 年达到量产成像标准仍不确定，灵动岛也可能因此保留。（来源：IT 之家）

11 月 11 日消息，任天堂美国公司近日设立新职位，负责保存、整理公司庞大的经典游戏资料。

据官方招聘信息，该职位工作地点位于华盛顿州雷德蒙德市，应聘者将负责任天堂历史硬件和软件信息的保存、整理和访问工作，为任天堂设计、建立一套结构化管理体系，用于整理旧平台相关的技术记录、工程文档、源材料及企业知识。

对于热爱电子游戏历史的人来说，这份工作颇具吸引力。任天堂希望应聘者具备档案管理、元数据管理、信息架构专业知识。应聘者入职后需要和工程、产品开发、法律和业务团队专家密切合作，确保经典史料能够长期保存，方便后代直接使用。

该职位采用 12 个月一期的合同工形式，时薪 35 美元-55 美元。任天堂优先考虑图书馆与信息科学、档案学、博物馆研究、信息管理、历史学、技术传播或相关本科专业的应聘者，但具备同等专业工作经验的人士也可能获得考虑（来源：IGN）

从2万亿美元到1万亿美元，全球AI估值体系正在经历一次现实检验。

Anthropic的IPO，原本被视为全球人工智能产业的一场资本盛宴。

这家Claude大模型的开发商，计划登陆纳斯达克，成为全球资本市场第一批接受公开市场检验的顶级AI实验室之一。按照此前投资者的预期，其上市估值一度有望达到2万亿美元。

先是2万亿美元的估值预期降至1.5万亿美元。随后，随着科技股调整、AI基础设施融资成本上升以及投资者重新审视公司的财务表现，部分潜在投资者开始讨论1万亿美元左右的估值。

从2万亿美元到1万亿美元，意味着市场对Anthropic的估值预期可能打了五折。

对于一家收入仍在高速增长的AI公司来说，1万亿美元依然是一个惊人的数字，但真正值得关注的是投资者为什么开始不愿意为它支付此前那么高的价格。

过去两年，中国大模型公司同样享受着全球AI产业带来的估值溢价。智谱、MiniMax、月之暗面、DeepSeek等企业，已经成为资本市场关注的对象。

当全球最具代表性的AI公司开始接受估值重估，国内大模型公司也将面临一次新的考验。

相反，它的收入增长速度，仍然处于全球科技行业最前列。

根据公司提交给美国证券交易委员会的IPO文件，2026年第一季度，Anthropic实现收入47.31亿美元；第二季度收入达到115.55亿美元；第三季度进一步增长至169.56亿美元。

这个数字并不低，但与此前的增长速度相比，已经出现明显放缓。第二季度收入较第一季度增长约144%，而第三季度的环比增速降至47%左右。

换句话说，Anthropic仍在快速增长，但增长的加速度正在下降。

此前，市场愿意给Anthropic接近2万亿美元的估值，很大程度上是因为投资者相信，生成式AI将成为一个持续扩张的市场，而Anthropic有机会成为其中最重要的基础设施提供商。

Claude在企业客户、软件开发和智能体应用中的渗透，为这种预期提供了支撑。

当一家公司的收入规模已经达到数百亿美元，投资者不会只关心它还能增长多少，也会开始追问：增长需要付出多大的成本？新增收入能否覆盖新增算力？利润率是否能够稳定下来？

2026年前三季度，公司累计收入达到332.42亿美元，远高于上年同期的25.45亿美元。

同期，公司按照美国通用会计准则计算的营业亏损为12.6亿美元。

如果按照公司自行定义的调整后营业利润计算，情况则有所不同：前三季度调整后营业利润达到40.81亿美元。

以第三季度为例，Anthropic实现调整后营业利润24.63亿美元，但按照GAAP口径，公司仍录得5.67亿美元营业亏损。

差异主要来自股份支付费用和非现金慈善捐赠等项目。公司第三季度分别将约10.7亿美元股份支付费用和19.6亿美元非现金慈善捐赠从调整后营业利润中剔除。

调整后盈利能够反映部分经营效率的改善，但投资者仍需要判断，这些调整项目中有多少具有持续性，以及股权激励带来的稀释成本应该如何计入估值。

Anthropic在IPO文件中披露，截至2026年9月30日及此后签订的算力采购和租赁协议，累计承诺支出约8954亿美元。

其中，约4475亿美元预计将在2030年底前发生，未来12个月需要支付的金额约698亿美元。

这不是一笔需要立即支付的账单，而是分布在未来多年、涉及算力采购和基础设施租赁的长期承诺。

截至2026年9月底，Anthropic拥有约1466亿美元流动性，包括现金、短期投资和可用信贷额度。

数字看起来足够庞大，但也说明了一件事：前沿大模型的竞争，已经不仅是研发投入的竞争，更是资本组织能力的竞争。

企业必须提前锁定数据中心、芯片和电力资源，才能保证模型训练与商业服务不受算力短缺影响。

如果模型需求持续增长，这些投入最终可以转化为规模优势；如果收入增长放缓，或者新一代模型很快改变市场竞争格局，提前签订的长期算力合同就可能成为沉重的财务负担。

Anthropic的估值变化，实际上反映了投资者对这笔长期投资开始变得谨慎。

Anthropic的估值变化之所以值得中国市场关注，是因为国内大模型公司的估值体系，同样建立在对未来市场空间的判断之上。

过去一段时间，资本市场对大模型公司的关注，主要集中在三个方面：

一是模型能力能否达到全球领先水平；二是Token消耗量能否持续增长；三是企业能否在全球AI产业链中占据重要位置。

这些指标当然重要，但它们并不直接等于收入，更不等于利润。

美国智库Rhodium Group在2026年9月发布的一份中国AI融资研究报告中，给出了一组值得关注的数据。

该机构统计的七家中国头部AI模型开发商，包括DeepSeek、月之暗面、智谱、MiniMax、阿里巴巴、字节跳动和快手。

这些公司的AI模型业务年化经常性收入（ARR）合计约107亿美元，仅相当于OpenAI和Anthropic两家公司相关收入规模的约10%。

中国大模型公司的用户规模和模型调用量正在增长，但从商业化收入来看，与美国头部企业仍然存在明显差距。

按照Rhodium Group当时的估算，Anthropic的估值与ARR之比约为21倍，OpenAI约为34倍。

尽管这些数字来自研究机构对企业估值和ARR的估算，并非统一口径下的公开市场市销率，不能直接视为完全可比的交易倍数，但它们至少说明一个问题：中国部分大模型公司的估值，已经包含了相当高的未来增长预期。

这意味着，一旦全球AI公司的估值锚发生变化，国内企业也很难完全置身事外。

过去，市场愿意为中国大模型公司的技术突破、国产替代和全球竞争潜力支付溢价。

现在，投资者可能会提出更具体的问题：这些公司究竟有多少收入来自真实付费客户？API业务能否形成稳定的规模效应？模型调用量增加之后，毛利率是否也会同步改善？

中国大模型公司面临的另一个问题，是商业模式与美国头部企业并不完全相同。

Anthropic的商业化路径相对清晰：通过Claude订阅、API调用以及企业级服务，将模型能力直接出售给客户。

对于企业来说，只要模型能够帮助其提高软件开发效率、降低运营成本或者替代部分人工工作，企业就有理由为这些能力付费。

一方面，国内云厂商、互联网公司和独立模型企业同时参与竞争；另一方面，开源模型的普及大幅降低了企业部署大模型的门槛。

模型能力越强，用户越容易获得低成本的智能服务，但模型开发商未必能够从中获得与模型价值相匹配的收入。

例如，一家企业可以使用开放权重模型自行部署，也可以通过第三方云服务商获得API服务。模型开发商即使获得了大量用户，也不一定能够从所有调用中直接获得收入。

Rhodium Group在报告中专门提到了这一问题。

在开放权重模型的商业模式下，如果第三方云服务商部署模型并对外提供API服务，模型开发商未必能够从中获得收入分成。

月之暗面和阿里巴巴已经开始尝试与主要模型使用方建立收入分成机制，但这仍然需要时间验证。

与此同时，国内市场的价格竞争也在压低模型公司的利润空间。

Rhodium Group的研究指出，中国企业客户的付费意愿、激烈的市场竞争以及开放权重模型的广泛应用，都在限制大模型公司的定价能力。

Anthropic面临的问题，是如何在庞大的算力投入之下维持高增长和高利润率。

中国大模型公司则需要同时解决两个问题：如何让模型获得更多用户，以及如何让用户愿意为模型付出足够高的价格。

如果只追求Token调用量，企业可以通过降低价格迅速扩大规模。

但如果收入增长速度赶不上推理成本下降的速度，规模越大未必意味着利润越高。

从这个角度看，模型调用量已经不再是衡量一家AI公司商业价值的充分指标。

真正重要的是，每增加一个Token，企业能够留下多少收入和毛利。

Anthropic和中国大模型公司还有一个重要区别：融资结构。

美国前沿AI实验室可以通过大型科技公司投资、云计算合作和公开市场融资获得资金。

Anthropic的投资者和合作伙伴中，包括谷歌、亚马逊等科技巨头。这些企业既提供资本，也提供算力和商业分发渠道。

中国大模型公司的融资结构则更多依赖股权融资、银行贷款以及产业资本支持。

Rhodium Group的研究显示，2026年前八个月，智谱、MiniMax、DeepSeek和月之暗面四家企业获得的私募股权投资、IPO融资及定向增发资金合计达到1790亿元人民币。

其中，智谱今年1月通过港股IPO融资约40亿元，7月又完成约270亿元的H股定向增发。

但需要注意的是，资本市场的融资能力并不等于企业自身的造血能力。

对于仍处于研发投入期的大模型公司来说，股权融资可以帮助它们维持模型迭代、购买算力和扩大团队。

但如果估值持续依赖下一轮融资，而不是来自经营现金流，那么一旦市场风险偏好下降，融资成本就可能明显上升。

这也是Anthropic此次IPO对国内市场最重要的启示。

它并不意味着中国大模型公司的估值必须跟随Anthropic下跌，也不意味着美国资本市场的定价体系可以直接套用到中国企业身上。

国产算力的发展、国内企业数字化需求、产业政策支持，以及开源模型带来的低成本扩张，都可能形成独立的估值逻辑。

资本市场可以为技术突破支付溢价，却很难永远为尚未兑现的商业前景买单。

对于智谱、MiniMax、月之暗面和DeepSeek来说，未来真正需要证明的，可能不只是模型能否继续追赶全球领先水平，而是能否在激烈的价格竞争中建立稳定的商业模式。

收入增长是否来自持续付费的企业客户，毛利率能否随着规模扩大而改善，推理成本是否持续下降，研发投入能否转化为产品收入，以及经营现金流能否逐渐覆盖算力投入。

这些指标看起来没有模型参数和榜单排名那么耀眼，却决定着一家大模型公司究竟是一家技术实验室，还是一家能够持续创造利润的科技企业。

Anthropic的IPO，最终可能成为全球AI产业的一次定价分水岭。

现在，投资者开始要求AI公司证明，这个未来究竟能够产生多少收入，又需要消耗多少资本。

OpenAI has acquired an AI travel agent called Odessia, according to Odessia’s founder, Francis Davidson. Davidson says in a post announcing the deal that he’s now working for OpenAI, helping the AI lab with the future of travel.

Terms of the deal were not disclosed, but this looks like an acqui-hire. Davidson’s announcement focused largely on how he built his AI travel agent Odessia by directing teams of AI agents. The year-old Odessia raised a $6 million pre-seed round led by Sequoia and launched its AI travel agent around five months ago. Davidson says that it had helped early adopters plan millions of dollars’ worth of travel, but the tool has already been shut down.

An OpenAI spokesperson confirmed the hire to TechCrunch. “We’re thrilled to welcome Francis to OpenAI. Francis is a proven founder who has built multiple businesses to help people travel, and we’re excited he’s chosen to build with us.”

However the AI lab has not announced new travel-specific products or plans. It does, however, count such companies as Bookings.com, Expedia, and KAYAK as customers or partners. Travel is also one of the main areas that people are using personal AI assistants to help with. And, back in July 2025, when OpenAI launched its ChatGPT agent, it mentioned travel as one of its potential uses.

OpenAI’s spokesperson didn’t have more to share on its plans for travel-related products, except to say that travel is one of the areas that chatbot users frequently ask about. “1.2 billion people turn to ChatGPT each week for help with everyday tasks — from understanding their health, figuring out what to make for dinner, building a budget, and even planning a trip. We see a real opportunity to make these experiences even more useful,” the spokesperson said.

Acquiring Odessia is interesting for another reason. Davidson is well known in the travel industry after he founded a travel startup called Sonder as a college student in 2014. It was sort of like Airbnb, but it focused on short-term leasing of upscale apartments in major cities worldwide. The pandemic badly hurt it, and as it climbed out of that rut, it went public via a SPAC but didn’t raise as much money as it needed, Davidson later said in a post announcing his resignation as CEO in June 2025.

When a key partnership with Marriott fell through, the company went into bankruptcy and wound down. The bankruptcy trustee sold Sonder’s name, trademarks, and website domain in 2026 to TravelAI, and that website operates as a curated guide to the kind of travel rental properties that Sonder was once known for. Prior to its downfall, Davidson had built Sonder into a unicorn with $143 million in revenues. While Sonder was not, ultimately, a success story, Davidson is the kind of battle-scarred founder that Silicon Valley often values.

So we’ll have to wait and see what OpenAI has in store now with travel, now that he’s joined the company.

IT之家 11 月 11 日消息，龙芯中科昨日宣布，基于自研智能机器车完成 ROS2 Jazzy 版本的全栈移植，贯通建图定位、手柄遥控、机械臂控制与深度视觉的完整链路。整车由龙芯 2K3000 处理器统一调度，具备环境感知与目标抓取能力。

ROS2（IT之家注：机器人操作系统第二版，Robot Operating System 2，机器人领域主流的开源中间件框架）凭借跨平台与分布式通信特性，将传感器、算法与执行器连成可复用的网络。本次全栈移植验证形成了一套可复用的国产机器人开发方案。

其核心算力来自龙芯 2K3000。该芯片采用 12nm 制程，集成 8 个基于自主龙架构的 LA364E 处理器核心，主频最高 2.5GHz。缓存配置为一级指令与数据缓存各 64KB，二级缓存共享 6MB。

龙芯方面披露，其单核性能可对标 ARM Cortex-A76 级别处理器，实测 SPEC CPU 2006 Base 单核定点分值达到 30 分。

感知系统分为两条链路。车身侧置激光雷达负责平面感知，机械臂末端的深度相机负责三维深度感知。龙芯针对室内场景完成参数校调，配合里程计互补，提升定位稳定性与建图完整度。

底盘控制方面，小车搭载麦克纳姆轮，通过组合四个电机转速，实现前后、横移、旋转与斜向的全向运动。主控板直插 USB 手柄，龙芯自研程序将摇杆量翻译为速度指令，并设有死区过滤与安全使能键。

龙芯方面表示，后续将补齐急停与看门狗功能，将动作组接入上层程序，并推进检测与点云融合的三维目标定位。从建图定位到机械臂抓取的完整链路，验证了龙芯 2K3000 在机器人运算处理与实时控制场景中的可行性，可为工业自动化、智能仓储等原型开发提供参考方案。

David Turturean, a recent MIT graduate and a member of the technical staff at the startup lab Physical Superintelligence (PSI), used early access to Anthropic’s Fable 5.2 model to solve an 18-year-old problem about quantum computing.

“I’m totally accepting the idea that this might be the last paper I ever put out,” Turturean, who deferred plans to pursue a master’s at MIT’s prestigious computer science and AI lab to join PSI, told TechCrunch. “In a few months, like, why would you even put out a paper?”

The problem in question, the Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture, concerns the ability of quantum computers to solve problems faster than classical ones. Scott Aaronson, one of the two researchers who posed the problem, writes that he doesn’t quite understand the proof but that he believes it’s correct because it was autoformalized in Lean, a coding language for math, and explained by a team of top researchers with whom PSI shared the solution.

The solution appears to close the door on one avenue quantum computers could follow to solve certain difficult problems at high speed, but not all of them. “It’s a negative result that allows people to know, okay, we’re no longer looking there,” Turturean said.

More broadly, it reflects the upheaval in the scientific world caused by AI problem-solving.

“A proof of full [Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture] was one of the last remaining open problems in quantum query complexity that everyone seemed to agree was centrally important,” Aaronson, who described himself feeling satisfied, awestruck, disappointed, and fatigued by the news, wrote. “I was surprised, honestly, to see it missing from OpenAI’s Mathocalypse dump a few weeks ago. Surely they tried it, so was it really so much harder than all the problems that were solved?”

That’s a point in favor of PSI’s model, which is to solve scientific problems with specialized model harnesses and scaffolding.

“An effective kind of research system should have lots of things related to harnesses, lots related to tools, memory systems, simulation infrastructure,” PSI CEO Matt Pines told TechCrunch. “You want to be able to really go after a problem at breadth and depth, and be able to consider a wide range of potential alternatives.”

For now, the company’s revenue comes from using its tools to optimize data centers, simulating the variables of heat, power, water, sound — “where the performance of that site as well as its impact on the community are a direct function of its physics.” The long play, however, is converting theoretical physics breakthroughs into actual technologies.

“Six to nine months ago, when I was talking to investors, like I had to sort of stretch to validate that conditional, right? Like, ‘no, no, no, trust me, pretty soon, theoretical physics is going to be mostly the domain of machines,’” Pines said. “And it’s not there yet, but it’s on its way.”

Still, while AI has claimed important solutions in fields like mathematics and computer science where it’s possible to express them in validated code, doing so in less abstracted disciplines like the life sciences or physics has proven more difficult. Last week, the startup Discovered Materials released a $1 million grand challenge for researchers using AI to understand problems like superconductivity and heat dissipation.

“At the end of the day, physics is different than math because it’s the real world … nature gets a vote in your models of reality,” Pines said. He said the startup is focused on understanding how to take computational results and validate them with experiments in the most efficient way possible.

“If it’s a true fact of nature, that’s a trick that you can exploit,” Pines said. “You could build a device out of it, right? The AI suggests an idea; it allows you to do something in the world you weren’t able to do before … and so each of those are kind of loops that PSI is building.”

As “neolabs for science” become a pathway for potentially groundbreaking science, the participants are still figuring out what the standards are for this new world. Because PSI had to hold its result until Anthropic’s model was nearly ready for release, they were able to share it with relevant researchers to better understand it.

“As an academic, we wanted to play our role in doing things the right way,” Jim Halverson, a professor at Northeastern University who advises PSI, said. He’ll be attending a summit at MIT next week where leading physicists will try to hash out a response to the new pace of science. “Best practices are still emerging … We figured that transparency is a good way to go, and contacting experts is a good way to go.”

“We had some time to sit on it … and it was the first time that I actually took one of my AI-elicited solutions on print, and I read through it, and I was like, okay, how can I make this … be presented more naturally for a human?” Turturean, who said the academic community will expect him to be able to explain the result, told TechCrunch. “And I think it also made me realize, oh my God, the weight of what AI can do.”

Every result here is a program we can run and test on fresh inputs, which makes a programming game a useful benchmark. Models get what a player can inspect, through text tools instead of a mouse and screenshots: the manual, visible test inputs, registers, and game feedback. They don’t get community code or exact records, only the game’s coarse score histograms.

Why test 100,000 inputs? The game checks a small set of cases per run. Our headline count requires a fresh-game replay and 100,000 passing tests on the independent TIS-100-CXX simulator, providing stronger evidence that a program generalizes to new inputs.

Undecimal Twin RounderSPEC44149538, one of the eight tournament puzzles, rounds an input to the nearest multiple of N on one output and of 11−N on the other. When we froze the leaderboard, the best community program took 2,694 cycles. Opus 5.5 passed its first program after 6.5 minutes, at 5,669 cycles. It went under the record 16 minutes in and finished at 1,918, which is 29% faster. That speed cost one more node and 28 more instructions than the old record.

The core of the program is a two-speed search. Instead of subtracting N one step at a time, nodes 5 and 6 subtract 4N until they overshoot, then add N back until the value turns positive. Each drives a small coprocessor, node 2 or node 7, by sending it jump offsets through a port, so the coprocessor works as a lookup table for 4N and N.

Opus 5.5 · 8 nodes · 88 instructions · passes 100,000 of 100,000 tests

Loading puzzle trajectories…

Best in-game score so far, before independent testing. Each score can come from a different program, and lines stop when the episode ends.

Five models got under the old record in-game. The other two cycle records are GPT-6.1 Sol’s 3,460 on Intersection IdentifierSPEC64160260, against 3,872 (11% faster), and Gemini 4 Argon’s 188 on Error: 8SPEC79324720, against 198 (5% faster). All three are on tournament puzzles, none in the main game. Of the 133 new frontier points, 18 beat a community record outright. The other 115 are new tradeoffs: better balances between the three scores than any community solution.

GPT-6.1 Sol reaches 75.6 record proximity at an estimated $0.75 per puzzle. Opus 5.5 reaches 77.2 at $5.08, 7 times the cost for 2 more points. Fable 5.1 is the most expensive at $7.19 and scores 70.2.

One point per model. Upper left is better.

Activity doesn’t explain quality either. GPT-6.1 Sol averages 136 game calls per puzzle at 75.6 record proximity; Gemini 4 Argon averages 41 at 76.2.

Mean game-tool calls per puzzle

New frontier points appear on 14 hard puzzles, 4 medium puzzles, and no easy ones. Long-running puzzles are harder to solve but easier to improve: on puzzles with a cycle record of 200 or less, 88% of episodes pass and 4% find a new point. Above 500 cycles, 76% pass and 8% find one.

Mean proximity to each community record · higher is better

Fraction solved · puzzles with new points below

Signal Multiplier43786 has no MUL. Gemini 4 Argon and GPT-6 Astra use JRO, a relative jump, to enter a block of repeated instructions at the right position. The jump selects how many copies of a value to send and add, saving the counter updates and branches of a multiplication loop.

Cycles per run · lower is better

Signal Window Filter60099 outputs the sums of the last three and last five inputs, so a solution has to remember history as well as add. Gemini 4 Argon’s four-node program uses SWP to rotate stored values and ADD/SUB to update running state. These programs move values between stacks to reach the requested slot, then read or replace it. MiMo-V2.6-Pro uses counted transfer loops; Opus 5.5 uses JRO to pick among unrolled transfers, spending extra instructions to save cycles.

Mean record proximity · same six puzzles per model · higher is better

Its profile showed node 2 working 86% of the time while nodes 1 and 3 spent 84% blocked waiting to write to it. GPT-6.1 Sol moved the branching out of node 2 and into those two neighbors. Mean elapsed minutes per puzzle · same episodes

Puzzles: Signal Multiplexer, Sequence Generator, Signal Edge Detector, Interrupt Handler, Sequence Peak Detector, and Signal Error Corrector.

In “After Math,” Silvia De Toffoli and Eamon Duede argue that a result only becomes a solution once mathematicians can understand it, and that AI fits better as an assistant than a competitor. TIS-100 is a small, measurable version of that future: a model finds a better program, and people turn it into something they understand.

Our count pools and deduplicates them across models and keeps the 133 on 18 puzzles with fresh-game replay and 100,000 passing tests. Testing is strong evidence of correctness, not proof.

Record proximity. The community record divided by the model’s best score, averaged across the three scores and all puzzles, ×100. Each score can come from a different program.

Limits. One episode per pair compares the configurations as tested and doesn’t measure repeated-run variability. Spread between puzzles is variation across tasks. Public puzzles may overlap with training data. Mechanic groups are our own labels.

Programs. Every model Pareto point’s program is public under the MIT License, in TIS-100 save format and named like the community leaderboard’s files (<puzzle>.<cycles>-<nodes>-<instructions>.txt). They are mirrored as one file per program on GitHub and as a table on Hugging Face. Two points replay in the game but fail some random tests; they are included and never count as new frontier points.

Resources. Costs are estimated from recorded October 2026 API list prices, including cache discounts. Tokens accumulate across responses, so repeated input counts again, and tokenizers differ. Game calls count individual dispatched tools, including errors, and exclude the automatic final submission.

Nvidia’s chips are powering America’s AI boom. Of course Chinese spies are interested.

As espionage targets go, Jensen Huang is perhaps one of the least surprising on Earth. The Nvidia CEO runs one of the world’s most valuable companies, controls the in-demand technology fueling the AI boom, and is cozy with presidents, CEOs, and all manner of important people. He also wears a cool leather jacket.

Which makes Huang’s admission that he had an affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy — reportedly while her spying was known to US intelligence and even President Donald Trump — all the more shocking. The fallout goes well beyond his marriage, his reputation, or Nvidia itself. Experts tell The Verge the incident threatens to disrupt the entire US AI industry, potentially jeopardize national security, and could undermine America’s efforts to maintain its fragile technological lead over China in AI.

“With those chips, the US lead could vanish in a matter of weeks or months.”

Nvidia is the undisputed leader in advanced computer chips, among the AI industry’s scarcest resources. While many ingredients go into building AI models — including talent, energy, capital, and data — top-tier chips are one of the most important, and Nvidia is one of a handful of companies with the expertise to design or manufacture them at the cutting edge. That makes it a gatekeeper to hardware that has become a key bottleneck in global AI development. US companies — including Meta, Anthropic, and OpenAI — are racing to develop chips of their own, in part to reduce their dependence on Nvidia, even as they spend billions securing ever more compute.

For China, the US’s main rival at the frontier of AI, that bottleneck is even tighter. To maintain its technological lead, the US has restricted the sale of the most advanced AI chips to the country in the hopes of slowing its progress in the sector, which has been impressive and is thought to trail the US by a matter of months. In response, China has made developing domestic alternatives a strategic national priority, though its leaders still lag Nvidia at the bleeding edge. At the same time, a thriving black market for restricted Nvidia chips has emerged.

Experts tell The Verge that China could exploit access to Nvidia to accelerate its own development, or to impede the US development of AI.

Getting its hands on more Nvidia chips is the most obvious win for Beijing, says Emily Kilcrease, a senior fellow and director of the energy, economics, and security program at the Center for a New American Security (CNAS) think tank. China has advantages in other parts of the AI race — including abundant energy and a solid ecosystem of open weight models — but without the latest Nvidia chips, it “cannot close the gap with US frontier capabilities,” Kilcrease tells The Verge. “With those chips, the US lead could vanish in a matter of weeks or months.”

It is not clear how successful the alleged spying operation has been on that front. There is no public evidence indicating that Huang himself has helped direct restricted Nvidia chips toward China or that sensitive information about them was obtained from him. But companies linked to the alleged spy, Alice Huang — no relation to Jensen — have reportedly enabled at least $7 billion of Nvidia chip sales to China.

Brookings fellow Kyle Chan tells The Verge that a concern for US industry could be that companies with alleged ties to China may have had priority access to Nvidia’s latest GPUs. “In a time of chip scarcity,” that would make it much harder for American companies to access them, Chan says.

Huang is also a prominent critic of American restrictions on chip sales, and Nvidia spends a formidable amount lobbying in Washington. Last year, he successfully secured White House approval to start exporting Nvidia’s H200 AI GPU chips to “approved customers” in China and other countries. Crucially, Huang also has the ear of President Trump as well as other world leaders, giving him great influence over policy decisions.

Hardware is not the only thing of value China could get from close access to Huang, Sunny Cheung, a fellow for China studies at the Jamestown Foundation think tank, tells The Verge. “I actually think too many people are focused on whether somebody managed to steal Nvidia’s trade secrets,” Cheung says, calling it a “very narrow way” of looking at espionage. “I would hope Jensen Huang isn’t foolish enough to hand over the blueprints for Nvidia’s next-generation chips to a suspected Chinese intelligence operative.”

The Nvidia CEO’s relationships with other tech executives, senior policymakers, and Trump himself give him an unusually intimate view into how some of the most powerful people in the US are thinking and planning. Beijing could use information on how American companies are planning major infrastructure expansions, their compute requirements, or broad industry trends to inform its own investments and industrial strategy, Cheung says.

Huang’s intelligence value could extend well beyond AI, too. “That information alone could be extremely valuable,” says Cheung, pointing to insights Beijing could glean into White House thinking about export controls or the private views of Silicon Valley executives on China and Taiwan.

“When so much of America’s AI infrastructure depends on one company, any significant security or governance problem at Nvidia can create uncertainty across the industry.”

But helping China advance is only one side of this equation. Disrupting Nvidia — as this scandal clearly has — could destabilize America’s entire AI industry. More than most companies, Nvidia is remarkably closely tied to the identity and reputation of its rockstar CEO. Huang cofounded the company more than three decades ago, and ever since then he has served as its president, chief executive, and a member of the board of directors. Despite holding a relatively small stake in the company, in many ways Nvidia is Jensen Huang. Nvidia shares have slumped since news of the affair broke.

Kilcrease echoes those concerns, warning that the scandal could “destabilize” the company. At the very least, she says the various investigations already underway “will consume an immense amount of bandwidth within the company,” creating a very real risk of weighing down Nvidia’s day-to-day operations. If those distractions begin to affect Nvidia’s ability to execute — slowing decisions, product rollouts, or the allocation of already scarce chips — the consequences could quickly reach customers. The AI labs and hyperscalers such as OpenAI and Anthropic “could have a real issue accessing the vast amounts of compute they need,” Kilcrease says, adding that switching to other hardware “takes time.”

In a race to build increasingly powerful AI, time is a precious resource. Experts say China trails the US closely, meaning that even modest delays for American companies can help Chinese rivals catch up. Nvidia is almost certain to face further disruption as investigations continue, though the extent to which the turmoil will roil the rest of the industry may be difficult to measure.

For China, however, the scandal could be about to backfire spectacularly now everything is out in the open. “The odds of AI chip control legislation being passed in Congress just went through the roof,” Kilcrease says.

Correction, Tuesday November 10th: A sentence in this article misstated that Anthropic is the leader in advanced computer chips. It is Nvidia.

Last year, he successfully secured White House approval to start exporting Nvidia’s H200 AI GPU chips to “approved customers” in China and other countries. Crucially, Huang also has the ear of President Trump as well as other world leaders, giving him great influence over policy decisions.

Hardware is not the only thing of value China could get from close access to Huang, Sunny Cheung, a fellow for China studies at the Jamestown Foundation think tank, tells The Verge. “I actually think too many people are focused on whether somebody managed to steal Nvidia’s trade secrets,” Cheung says, calling it a “very narrow way” of looking at espionage. “I would hope Jensen Huang isn’t foolish enough to hand over the blueprints for Nvidia’s next-generation chips to a suspected Chinese intelligence operative.”

The Nvidia CEO’s relationships with other tech executives, senior policymakers, and Trump himself give him an unusually intimate view into how some of the most powerful people in the US are thinking and planning. Beijing could use information on how American companies are planning major infrastructure expansions, their compute requirements, or broad industry trends to inform its own investments and industrial strategy, Cheung says.

Huang’s intelligence value could extend well beyond AI, too. “That information alone could be extremely valuable,” says Cheung, pointing to insights Beijing could glean into White House thinking about export controls or the private views of Silicon Valley executives on China and Taiwan.

“When so much of America’s AI infrastructure depends on one company, any significant security or governance problem at Nvidia can create uncertainty across the industry.”

But helping China advance is only one side of this equation. Disrupting Nvidia — as this scandal clearly has — could destabilize America’s entire AI industry. More than most companies, Nvidia is remarkably closely tied to the identity and reputation of its rockstar CEO. Huang cofounded the company more than three decades ago, and ever since then he has served as its president, chief executive, and a member of the board of directors. Despite holding a relatively small stake in the company, in many ways Nvidia is Jensen Huang. Nvidia shares have slumped since news of the affair broke.

Kilcrease echoes those concerns, warning that the scandal could “destabilize” the company. At the very least, she says the various investigations already underway “will consume an immense amount of bandwidth within the company,” creating a very real risk of weighing down Nvidia’s day-to-day operations. If those distractions begin to affect Nvidia’s ability to execute — slowing decisions, product rollouts, or the allocation of already scarce chips — the consequences could quickly reach customers. The AI labs and hyperscalers such as OpenAI and Anthropic “could have a real issue accessing the vast amounts of compute they need,” Kilcrease says, adding that switching to other hardware “takes time.”

In a race to build increasingly powerful AI, time is a precious resource. Experts say China trails the US closely, meaning that even modest delays for American companies can help Chinese rivals catch up. Nvidia is almost certain to face further disruption as investigations continue, though the extent to which the turmoil will roil the rest of the industry may be difficult to measure.

For China, however, the scandal could be about to backfire spectacularly now everything is out in the open. “The odds of AI chip control legislation being passed in Congress just went through the roof,” Kilcrease says.

Nvidia co-founder CEO Jensen Huang has never been as flashy or controversy-prone as AI leaders like OpenAI’s Sam Altman or SpaceXAI’s Elon Musk. Now, the 63-year-old industry kingpin has admitted that he cheated on his wife of 40 years in an affair that could have ramifications beyond Huang’s personal life and potentially impact national security.

United States officials believe that Huang’s likely romantic interest, Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, is a Chinese spy who has been feeding information back to Beijing. (Alice Huang, a Chinese citizen, is of no relation to Jensen Huang.)

Megaspeed, a Singapore-based AI infrastructure company, had reportedly purchased $4.8 billion in Nvidia chips over the last two years. The U.S. and Singapore have both previously investigated Megaspeed over suspicions that the firm was illegally sharing chips with China.

The U.S. and China are embroiled in a fierce technological arms race to build the most advanced AI infrastructure, which could shape each country’s economic future, military prowess, and capacity for innovation. Nvidia is valuable in this competition as one of the world’s largest makers of AI chips, which are essential for accelerating AI development. But as an American company, Nvidia faces government restrictions on the sale of its most powerful chips to Chinese entities.

As the controversy unfolds, we are organizing the most relevant events into a reverse-chronological timeline to keep you up to date.

The Nvidia CEO pulled out of upcoming speaking engagements at the ElevenLabs Summit and Anthropic CEO Forum.

Alice Huang and her family reportedly built a network of companies in China and Singapore to acquire Nvidia chips, including founding a Chinese company called Shanghai Century Litong. Founded in 2023, it became an Nvidia-preferred cloud partner, giving it priority access to chips, The Information reported. The Information also reported that Shanghai Century Litong facilitated buying $7.5 billion worth of Nvidia’s chips, including banned chips.

Nvidia’s head lawyer, Tim Teter, intervened in a 2025 U.S. government probe surrounding the suspected smuggling of AI chips by Megaspeed International, Bloomberg reported. Teter contacted Commerce Under Secretary Jeffrey Kessler asking questions about whether the Trump administration played a role in detaining Alice Huang.

In early 2025, Alice Huang and a business partner sought China-based investors for an Asian data center, promising they had no problem in securing GPUs, the Financial Times reported.

On Sunday night, President Trump weighed in on Huang’s controversy and showed support for the Nvidia CEO.

“I have not spoken to him about it. I just know he’s a fine person, but you never know what’s going on,” Trump said.

When asked if Huang should remain chief of Nvidia, Trump said, “I think so. Oh yeah, sure.”

Jensen Huang wrote in a letter to Nvidia employees — which was also published as a press release — that he cheated on his wife.

“I owe my family and all of you an apology,” Huang told his company. “I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry.”

Huang did not mention Alice Huang by name in the message, but linked his infidelity to “the national security concerns raised in news reports.”

“Nvidia’s Board of Directors has initiated an independent investigation. I support the investigation and will cooperate fully. I love our country and our company. I am committed to protecting Nvidia and supporting America’s national security. I am proud and grateful to be an American,” Huang wrote.

Nvidia shares slid over 5% the following day.

Three Republican congressmen — Chairman John Moolenaar of the House Select Committee on China, Chairman Brian Mast of the House Foreign Affairs Committee, and Chairman Rick Crawford of the House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence — sent a request to Huang for a closed-door joint briefing with their three committees.

“Recent reports raise significant national security concerns regarding the [People’s Republic of China]’s access to sensitive U.S. technology and information,” the chairmen wrote. “The issue of PRC infiltration and access to cutting-edge U.S. technology is core to the investigative work of our three committees this Congress. It is vital that Congress determines the extent to which U.S. national security has been placed at risk.”

U.S. officials had been investigating Alice Huang and Megaspeed for more than a year when the New York Times broke the story in late October that the two executives also had a close relationship.

An Nvidia spokesperson denied that this relationship was something out of the ordinary.

“Jensen’s interactions with Ms. Huang are not unusual or unexpected. Meetings with customers are part of a CEO’s job; Jensen talks with thousands of customer executives every year,” Nvidia spokesperson John Rizzo said. He added that “if the U.S. government believes that any person is a threat to American industry, it would let us know.”

U.S. officials circulated a secret memo among policymakers that warned that Megaspeed’s Alice Huang, who had a relationship with Jensen Huang, was a spy for China’s Ministry of State Security. This memo was not public knowledge until it was later reported by the New York Times.

Secretary of State Marco Rubio supervised the drafting of the memo.

Around the same time, per the New York Times’ report, U.S. President Donald Trump was briefed about intelligence findings that possible Chinese spy Alice Huang had formed a close relationship with Jensen Huang. Trump did not act on this information.

The Nvidia CEO, an ally of Trump, has repeatedly advocated for the U.S. government to let Nvidia expand its business in China.

Megaspeed was confirmed to be under investigation by both the U.S. and Singaporean governments in October 2025. As a customer of Nvidia, Megaspeed was suspected of helping Chinese companies get around American embargoes on chip exports.

Megaspeed, a neocloud that used Nvidia chips, had been renting computing power to Chinese internet giant Alibaba and other Chinese companies, the Times reported. A Commerce Department official who had visited Megaspeed’s data center in Malaysia in 2024 had found a hoard of Nvidia equipment that was still packed in boxes and the concern was that this equipment was being directly shipped somewhere else, like China, rather than installed and sold as a cloud service.

Jensen Huang had been spotted socializing with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang as early as 2024 in Taiwan, where the Nvidia CEO was born.

These investigations into Megaspeed highlighted concerns about the degree to which Nvidia is able to track its chip exports. At the time, an Nvidia spokesperson told press that the company did not have “any reason to believe products had been diverted.”

“NVIDIA visited multiple Megaspeed sites yet again earlier this week and confirmed what we previously observed — Megaspeed is running a small commercial cloud, like many other companies throughout the world, as allowed by U.S. export control rules,” the Nvidia spokesperson said at the time.

IT之家 11 月 11 日消息，摩尔线程今天宣布，公司旗下 AI 训推一体智算卡 MTT S5000 及 MUSA 软件栈，已在昨天（开源当日）适配 MiniMax 图像生成模型 H3-Image。

IT之家了解到，MiniMax H3-Image 是一款衍生自 H3 的图像生成模型，具备文本生成图像、图像参考和图像编辑能力。它可在 10 秒内生成一张 4096 × 4096 像素、约 16MP（4K）的高分辨率图像，速度可达市面主流水平的 5 倍，同时呈现丰富、真实的细节，并具备优秀的指令遵循和多参考图理解能力。

针对 MiniMax H3-Image 的核心能力特征，摩尔线程基于 MTT S5000 进行全链路适配和深度优化：

扩散类生图与编辑模型注意力机制开销较大，Attention 占比高，尤其在多参考图输入的场景下 Key / Value 膨胀明显，参考图越多开销上升越快。MTT S5000 凭借高算力密度，可从容承接此类模型在理解与高分辨率生成过程中的高计算负载，充分释放 MiniMax H3-Image 的效能。

摩尔线程此前已在 MiniMax H3 模型上，完成了 Attention、GEMM 等核心算子，以及通信与运行时等底层基础设施建设。此次面对 MiniMax H3-Image，团队结合视觉生成模型优化经验，复用 SGLang、MATE、MCCL 等成熟组件能力完成适配，同时也为后续更多生图、生视频模型的 Day-0 适配奠定了基础。

中新网安塔利亚11月11日电 (陈溯 王庆凯 柳棽)《联合国气候变化框架公约》第31次缔约方大会(COP31)正在土耳其安塔利亚召开。当地时间11月10日上午，由习近平生态文明思想研究中心、中国新闻社主办，生态环境部环境与经济政策研究中心、中国新闻网协办的“生态文明与美丽中国实践”边会在中国角举行。诺华全球社会影响负责人兼首席可持续发展官芭芭拉·弗雷德(Barbara Vrede)发表致辞，分享诺华在中国推进环境可持续发展的实践，并重点介绍了四川林业碳汇、社区与生物多样性项目，强调环境行动应兼顾生态、社会与经济价值。

弗雷德表示，人类健康与地球健康息息相关，社会影响与可持续发展旨在为人类和地球创造更健康的未来，环境可持续发展已融入企业战略。

她指出，一个多世纪以来，中国一直是诺华发展历程中的重要组成部分，也是诺华将全球社会影响与可持续发展愿景转化为本地行动的重要国家。诺华与政府、社区、专家及其他合作伙伴携手，致力于创造长远的环境与社会价值。在中国，诺华着力减少自身运营场所的碳排放，并与供应商密切合作，协同推进供应链减碳。

谈及具体实践，弗雷德重点介绍了诺华长期开展的四川林业碳汇、社区与生物多样性项目。该项目于2010年启动，从最初基于造林的碳减排倡议，逐步发展为涵盖生态修复、生物多样性保护和社区发展的长期合作项目。

据介绍，该项目已营造近4000公顷森林，在五个县和三个自然保护区内种植约2100万棵树，惠及4200多户当地家庭和18000多名居民，并为当地社区创造约4000万元人民币的劳动收入。弗雷德表示，这一实践表明，环境行动能够同时创造生态、社会和经济价值。

弗雷德表示，诺华很高兴看到这一长期实践，获评中国生态环境部优秀ESG(环境-社会-治理)案例。但她同时指出，认可并非终点，诺华将继续从项目经验中学习，探索此类长期实践如何为生态修复、生物多样性、高质量碳汇和社区可持续发展等领域贡献有益经验。

她表示，气候变化、自然损失、社区韧性和人类健康等议题密切关联。全球目标只有真正落地、产生实实在在的影响，才能切实发挥价值。诺华期待继续与中国政府、社区、专家和合作伙伴携手，在长期实践经验基础上持续努力，为人类、社区和地球创造更健康、更可持续的未来。(完) 【编辑:管娜】

浩瀚的太平洋，连接亚洲、大洋洲、北美洲和南美洲。亚太经合组织(APEC)21个经济体，因海相望，因合作相聚。亚太经合组织第三十三次领导人非正式会议即将拉开帷幕。APEC是个什么样的组织？

APEC是4个英文单词的缩写，A是Asia，代表亚洲。P是Pacific，代表太平洋，这两个字母代表它的成员从哪里来。E—Economic，经济，告诉大家它是搞经济的，C—Cooperation代表合作，这4个字母合起来就是“亚太经合组织”的简称APEC。

1989年正式成立后至今，APEC已成为亚太地区层级最高、领域最广、最具影响力的经济合作机制。

APEC现有21个成员，发达成员与发展中成员并存，还有中国香港和中国台北两个地区经济体。此外，APEC还有3个观察员，分别是东盟(ASEAN)秘书处、太平洋经济合作理事会(PECC)、太平洋岛国论坛(PIF)秘书处。

目前，其成员经济总量占全球约六成，贸易额占比近一半，覆盖约30亿人口。如果把亚太经合组织比作一架大马车的话，这驾马车上的21个成员影响着大半个地球的发展，它早已是全球经济名副其实的“压舱石”。 【编辑:蔡星雨】

中新网11月11日电 据《以色列时报》报道，当地时间11月10日，以色列第26届议会新任议员宣誓就职，议会于当天举行首次会议。新一届议会由120名议员组成。

据报道，看守政府总理内塔尼亚胡在发言时称，伊朗正“试图重启核武器进程”，消除这一“威胁”的唯一途径是“推翻伊朗政权”，他再次呼吁各党派与他组成“民族团结政府”。内塔尼亚胡领导的右翼阵营在10月27日举行的议会选举中失去多数席位。

报道称，正直党领导人加迪·埃森科特依靠的四个政党联盟仅拥有48个议席，未达到组阁所需的61席多数。在以色列议会开幕前夕，埃森科特表示，他致力于尽快组建“国家紧急政府”，同时不会放弃自身原则。

据此前报道，以色列总统赫尔佐格8日正式授权埃森科特组建新政府。根据以色列法律，埃森科特有28天时间组建新政府，必要时可申请最多延长14天。

以色列媒体Ynet新闻网发文分析称，埃森科特的组阁前景并不乐观。若拉拢极端正统派政党入阁并争取阿拉伯裔政党外部支持，虽可凑足多数席位，但难以解决相关立法争议；若组建仅48席的少数政府，则因阵营内右翼伙伴及部分潜在盟友反对，且远低于61席门槛，难以稳定运转；与内塔尼亚胡组建团结政府，双方目前均缺乏兴趣。 【编辑:孔庆玲】

中新网广州11月11日电 (许青青 曾旺添)超大型油轮“壮丽海港”轮(HARBOUR SPLENDOR)10日靠泊广州港三门岛锚地，在黄埔海关“锚地直提”顺势监管保障下，该轮顺利完成3万吨进口原油“锚地直提”作业，随后转港驶往惠州。

据悉，本次作业是全国首票进口原油“锚地直提”业务，也是广州港时隔15年重启锚地原油进口业务，为国际原油进入华南地区炼化基地提供了一个海上新通道。

据了解，当前国际原油海运运费暴涨，企业普遍选用超大型油轮开展远洋运输，摊薄单位运输成本。部分货主企业自有码头受其所在进港航道水深条件限制，难以直接靠泊作业，需在海上提前减载驳运。

“这艘‘壮丽海港’轮装载原油约27万吨、吃水深，广州港三门岛锚地水深条件优越，紧邻广州、惠州等大型炼化基地，是理想的海上过驳作业平台。”广州港石油化工港务分公司副总经理张明表示。

黄埔海关作为三门岛锚地的主管海关，近年推出“锚地直提直装”监管模式，海关监管从“岸上”前移到“海上”，国际油轮在海上锚地即可直接完成验放和驳运。

为保障本次作业安全顺畅，黄埔海关所属黄埔老港海关提前对接船舶配载、作业计划，制定涵盖申报征税、查验检疫、取样送检、监管放行等全链条的安全监管和通关作业预案，组建专业团队提前进驻锚地附近作业区域，确保“船到即检”。

监管环节海关实施“一次登临、一次放行”，同时采取“先放后检”模式，抽样送检与货物提离并行开展，企业无需等待实验室检测结果，便可开展转运作业。期间依托锚地智慧监管平台，最大限度减少对现场作业的影响。

“原油在三门岛锚地直提后，油轮吃水同步降低，能满足后续靠泊作业条件，整体还可节省2-3天船期。我们算过一笔账，通过这套海上直提驳运方案，单船可节约运输成本上千万元。”中国石油化工股份有限公司广州分公司业务主管何永钊表示。

据统计，今年1-10月，黄埔海关运用“锚地直提直装”模式累计监管进出口大宗商品超880万吨、船舶和海洋工程装备37批次，货物总值超170亿元，同比增长15.7%。

黄埔老港海关船舶监管办事处主任郭庆表示，下一步海关将用好大屿山、三门岛锚地常态化开放的有利契机，持续优化监管服务，释放锚地作业潜能。(完)

中新社华盛顿11月10日电 (记者 陈孟统)美国国会众议院10日通过一项程序性动议，搁置了旨在推动弹劾国防部长赫格塞思的决议案。

美国共和党籍联邦众议员托马斯·梅西9日提出决议，推动众议院就弹劾赫格塞思举行投票。这份决议案共列出8项弹劾条款，其中3项涉及伊朗战事。

在10日举行的一场程序性投票中，众议院以211票赞成、204票反对，决定将这份弹劾决议案提交委员会审议，实际上阻止了相关弹劾程序在本届国会任期内继续推进。

投票结果基本呈现党派分野，梅西是唯一与民主党人一道投反对票的共和党议员。

当天上午，赫格塞思在五角大楼举行记者会，就国会的弹劾动议作出回应。他指责梅西的行为“是一场政治闹剧”。

在上述程序性投票结果公布后，美国总统特朗普通过社交媒体表示，这是对赫格塞思的正名，同时指责民主党将弹劾作为政治武器。

赫格塞思并不是首位遭到弹劾的内阁成员。最近一位遭弹劾的是拜登政府时期的国土安全部长马约卡斯。2024年，他因边境安全问题遭到众议院弹劾，但参议院随后驳回全部弹劾指控，未进入正式审判程序。(完) 【编辑:管娜】

《本草纲目》里最早记载了怎么喝咖啡？郑和下西洋的宝船已经用上了蒸汽机？乍一听，这些说法荒诞不经，但是在一些短视频平台上，它们却被包装成足以推翻教科书的“历史新发现”。

这些所谓的“新发现”、视频里呈现的“铁证”，往往连最基础的文献检索和历史常识都经不起推敲。荒谬的“伪史论”究竟是如何被炮制出来的？背后又藏着怎样一条筛选受众、卖课带货的灰色利益链？

在短视频平台上，各类打着“颠覆认知”旗号的伪史视频五花八门：有人宣称古埃及金字塔是近代混凝土浇筑的，有人言之凿凿地声称明朝《永乐大典》第18234卷记载了郑和宝船使用“蒸汽火轮机”，还有博主宣称，人类历史上最早记录咖啡的典籍是《本草纲目》。

伪史博主称网上很容易就能搜到《本草纲目》里关于咖啡要配牛奶或加糖的说法，还称《本草纲目》传到欧洲后，欧洲才开始大规模种植咖啡；有了咖啡，才有了从中国传过去的煮热水习惯。

面对网上层出不穷的伪史谣言，科普作家河森堡近期制作了多期《肘击伪史论》短视频逐一辟谣。他发现，许多看似头头是道的“古籍铁证”，只需一次最基础的全文检索就能戳破。

河森堡：这个谣言很容易澄清，在《本草纲目》全书检索“咖啡”这个关键词，没有任何结果。不止明代，到了清代，《康熙字典》中都找不到咖啡的“咖”字。咖啡真正进入中国，已经是清代中后期的事了。

除了凭空捏造古籍，另一类伪史论则是拿中学课本里的基础常识“做文章”。

伪史博主：2026年人教版历史教材的地名标注变了。第12课写着：今北京在历史上叫南京，今河南开封在历史上叫东京，古代史中经常出现的大秦，在这本教科书里直接标注为罗马帝国。这意味着历史版图被刻意更改、缩小过。

如此荒谬的教科书解读，偷换概念、断章取义，拿课本做幌子，既可能迷惑学生，又误导广大网友。

河森堡：其中一页插图内容讲的是宋辽时期。当时辽国国土大部分在北方，今天的北京在当时被定为“南京析津府”；北宋时期开封汴梁被称为“东京”；把罗马称为“大秦”，《后汉书》里就有记载。这些都是常识问题，却被一些伪史博主当成藏着天大的阴谋。这样错漏百出、是非颠倒的视频，在视频号上能有一千多个点赞。

中国科学技术大学科技传播系副主任袁岚峰长期在网络上批驳伪史论，他也明显感受到，这股风潮在近十年间经历了剧烈的膨胀与激进化。

袁岚峰：2015年，常见的说法只是中国古代科技很先进这类老生常谈，那时还没有出现把国外所有成果都归于中国这种说法。如今一旦有内容不符合这类人的预期，他们通常有两种做法：一是说这是假的、是伪史，二是把原因归咎于某个对象。这类内容只输出情绪，完全不管真实性。

一段来源可疑的史料，怎样被包装成看似证据确凿的视频？伪史论能层出不穷地发明“历史”，究竟是谁在推波助澜？我们又该如何甄别这些历史相关的谣言呢？

中国传媒大学信息传播学院院长李舒注意到，这类内容往往按照相似的步骤进行包装——绕过思考，直接给出答案。

李舒：这类内容先用一个真实的碎片打底，比如开头放一段真实的考古画面，后面接上的往往是跟它没有实质关系的错误结论；再用声音和剪辑绕过思考，配上“科学已经确证”这类斩钉截铁的字幕，形成一个完整的逻辑闭环；加上很快的画面、很满的旁白，不给观众停下来思考和追问证据的空间；最后用不可证伪的说法封住退路，凡是和它的结论相冲突的文献、文物，它就用一句“后人伪造”搪塞过去。

违背常识的言论，制作者自己真的相信吗？河森堡发现，许多鼓吹伪史论的博主其实是“揣着明白装糊涂”——有人在自己早年出版的图书里还正常引用亚里士多德的学术观点，到了镜头前却为了迎合情绪高喊“亚里士多德根本不存在”。在这场流量生意里，夸张的伪史言论往往只是一张用来筛选受众、实现高转化变现的“筛子”。

河森堡：绝大多数伪史博主自己并不相信伪史论。有人直接带货，店铺里挂着所谓的书或者日用品，转成生意；也有人先把这部分人聚拢起来，再向他们卖课。他们用极端反智的内容“提纯”受众。

河森堡告诉记者，最初他只是偶然刷到某条伪史论视频，为了全面批驳其中的荒谬逻辑，他必须耐着性子把整条视频看完。没想到，正是这个“看完视频”的动作，让他掉进了平台算法的推荐漩涡。

河森堡：一旦看完，收看时长会让算法误以为我喜欢这类内容，之后便不停地推送。看完一个伪史论博主，接着就被推七八个，最后几十个，没完没了。

华东师范大学传播学教授甘莅豪认为，此类伪史内容早年间只在特定的小圈子内流传，但在算法时代，猎奇的伪史论因自带流量而被进一步放大。

甘莅豪：算法推荐机制并不关心内容是否真实，平台只关心视频有多少完播、评论、点赞、转发和停留时长。如果视频博人眼球、转发量高，就会让制作者获得很大流量，这种流量就有利可图。

李舒认为，伪史传播的危害，远不止搞错几个具体的历史常识，甚至可能会影响青少年一代唯物史观的建立。

李舒：这类内容的危害不在于具体说错了哪段历史，而在于培养了一种无需证据也可以确信的认知习惯，从整体上弱化了社会的逻辑思辨能力。它危害文化安全，制造圈层对立，其中一些极端认知带有鲜明的历史虚无主义特征。特别是对于历史认知正在形成的青少年，非常容易误导他们，影响年轻一代唯物史观的建立。

对平台来说，不能把争议当流量，更应该把辨别、审核的关口前移。

李舒：平台要管好入口，不能把争议当流量。伪史内容的监督有一个非常现实的难题：历史类内容没有当事方，不像名誉侵权那样有具体受害人可以投诉，平台难以依据举报作出处理。所以平台不能等举报才动，必须把审核门槛前移。对缺乏可靠史料支撑、以掩盖真相为核心的内容，要自觉、主动降低推荐权重，而不是等它大面积传播后再删除、限流。

中新网昆明11月11日电 (汪劲饶 曾庆明 马舒娴)昆明海关11日消息，10月15日至11月10日，昆明市跨境电商商品经昆明机场口岸空运出口货值超1300万元(人民币，下同)。受国内“双十一”促销与海外年末消费旺季备货叠加带动，服饰、箱包、彩妆等“中国制造”商品海外订单明显增长。

近年来，“反向海淘”在海外持续走红，越来越多海外消费者通过电商平台选购中国商品。今年“双十一”期间，多家海外电商平台同步推出促销活动，进一步带动跨境电商出口订单增长。

“今年‘双十一’促销周期长，又赶上海外年末消费旺季。10月中下旬以来，服饰、箱包、彩妆类商品的海外订单量持续增多，较平日增长1.5倍。”昆明一物流企业副总经理荆济腾说。

在昆明综合保税区跨境电商仓库，服装、节庆用品等商品经扫码复核、装箱封装，由海关监管验放后运抵昆明长水国际机场，发往新加坡、马来西亚等海外市场。

针对企业夜间集货、凌晨航班出运的特点，昆明海关所属昆明邮局海关、昆明长水机场海关实行“7×24小时”预约通关，并安排现场值守，保障出口商品准点配载、按期交付。

出口走俏的同时，跨境电商进口退货难题也有了新解法。今年“双十一”期间，昆明综合保税区跨境电商进口退货中心仓投入运行，退货商品可集中入区、统一核验、分类处置。

“以前跨境电商退货流程繁琐、处置成本高。现在符合要求的退货商品可以重新上架销售，有效盘活库存资源。”云南自由贸易试验区投资开发(集团)有限公司副总经理王伟说。(完)

商务部发声！持续扩大“丝路电商”朋友圈，推动伙伴国优质商品进入我国市场

商务部将扩大“丝路电商”朋友圈，持续开展“丝路电商惠全球”主题活动，推动伙伴国优质产品通过电商渠道进入我国市场。

国家发展改革委周三召开奋进“十五五”系列新闻发布会，介绍共建“一带一路”有关情况。

商务部综合司一级巡视员宋立洪在发布会上表示，“十四五”时期，商务部坚持共商共建共享，与有关国家一道，持续拓展“一带一路”经贸合作互利空间，贸易投资规模持续扩大，合作质量稳步提升，效果不断彰显，有力促进了共建国家经济和社会发展，为建设开放型世界经济、推动构建人类命运共同体作出积极贡献。

宋立洪表示，“十五五”时期，将按照“十五五”规划纲要部署，重点从四个方面持续深化“一带一路”经贸合作。

一是推动贸易创新发展。宋立洪表示，商务部将深化与共建国家绿色贸易、跨境电商等合作，推动新兴产业外贸产品进出口，扩大自共建国家优质商品进口，更好促进共建国家产业发展。继续给予同我国建交的最不发达国家零关税待遇，落实对非洲建交国全面实施零关税举措。大力发展服务贸易，促进研发、设计等贸易合作，推进实施对外文化贸易“千帆出海”行动计划。不断扩大数字贸易。

二是持续深化双向投资。宋立洪表示，商务部将促进对共建国家投资合作，加强产业链供应链合作，推动商签绿色发展、数字经济、蓝色经济、产供链合作等领域合作文件，引导企业稳步参与绿色能源、绿色矿产、数字经济、人工智能等新兴领域合作。健全海外综合服务体系，建好用好“一港一站一平台”，发挥境外经贸合作区等平台作用。精心打造“投资中国”品牌，营造一流营商环境，吸引更多共建国家来华投资。

三是推进项目落地见效。商务部表示，接下来将促进对外承包工程提质增效，深化绿色基建、新型基建等领域合作，不断提升重大合作项目影响力，实现互利共赢。提升援外执行质效，精心组织实施更多农业、交通、卫生、教育、环保、减贫等民生领域项目。继续做强菌草技术、“云上大讲堂”等“小而美”品牌。推进中国马来西亚、中国印尼“两国双园”合作。

除了上述三个方面，商务部将充分发挥双边经贸联委会、贸易畅通工作组、投资合作工作组等机制作用，加强与共建国家沟通对接。

宋立洪在发布会上特别提到，商务部将扩大“丝路电商”朋友圈，持续开展“丝路电商惠全球”主题活动，推动伙伴国优质产品通过电商渠道进入我国市场。继续办好中国进出口商品交易会、中国国际进口博览会、中国国际服务贸易交易会、全球数字贸易博览会、中国国际投资贸易洽谈会等重大展会，搭建共建国家之间经贸交流合作的平台。

电商的促销活动中，网络直播带货中，有些主播会作出“保证正品”“售后兜底”“假一赔十”等承诺，这些口头承诺算不算数，有没有法律效力？一旦买到假货，销售商家、带货主播、网络平台，到底谁来兑现赔偿？来看最高人民法院发布的一起典型案例。

周女士在一家购物公司直播间主播的推荐下，在某商贸公司开设的“美妆专营店”花费1859元购买了一瓶面霜。直播过程中，主播当众作出售后兜底的承诺。

主播介绍，这款面霜是专柜正品，资质齐全、可溯源。但周女士收货比对后，发现商品存在问题，委托专业机构鉴定，确认商品并非正品，鉴定花费500元。

事后，商贸公司虽然口头答应，按照四倍货款加上鉴定费进行赔偿，却迟迟没有兑现。周女士多次沟通无果后诉至法院，要求商贸公司、直播购物公司承担赔偿责任，同时主张网络平台承担连带赔偿责任。

直播带货中，推广方承诺兜底赔付的情况并不少见。可一旦消费者维权，各方却经常相互推诿。销售商家、直播推广方，责任该如何划分？

丽水市莲都区人民法院民二庭庭长 朱海峰：销售方是商品质量和违约赔偿的第一责任人。本案中，买卖合同的出卖人是这家商贸公司，需要承担卖方对应的法律责任。而购物公司作为直播推广方，主播在直播间公开作出赔付到底、售后兜底的承诺，该承诺属于对外作出的真实意思表示，不违反法律、行政法规的强制性规定，具备法律约束力，因此直播推广方应当依法承担相应连带责任。

法官表示，周女士正是出于对主播承诺的信任，通过直播间链接下单购买面霜，这份公开承诺构成有效约定，购物公司应当按照承诺履行兜底赔付义务。与此同时，法院也对网络平台是否应当承担责任作出审查。

朱海峰：平台没有参与本次交易，也没有作出赔付承诺，并且已经依法履行商家资质审核、信息公示等义务。按照消费者权益保护法，只有平台无法向消费者提供商家真实信息时，消费者才能要求平台先行赔付。

最终，浙江省丽水市莲都区人民法院依据《中华人民共和国民法典》第五百八十五条判决商贸公司按照货值四倍退赔周女士7936元，直播购物公司对这笔款项承担连带责任，驳回周女士要求平台赔偿的诉讼请求。一审判决后，双方均未提起上诉。

法官介绍，主播在直播中公开承诺“假一赔四”“假一赔十”等虽然高于法定标准的赔偿，但并不违反法律强制性规定，具有法律效力，经营者应当履约兑现。法官提醒直播从业者，直播间口头承诺并非营销空话，一经发布即需承担相应的法律责任。

直播购物如果遭遇货不对板、虚假宣传、承诺不兑现等消费纠纷，消费者该怎样留存证据，依法维权？法官给出实用指引。

法官介绍，在审理直播带货纠纷案件时，直播录屏回放是维权的核心证据。直播间的宣传、口头赔付承诺，大多只在直播瞬间出现，一旦直播结束，取证难度会大幅增加。

丽水市莲都区人民法院副院长 涂诗雨：消费者下单前，可以在直播间弹幕向主播提问，确认商品品牌、材质、售后、赔付承诺等关键信息，在得到主播明确答复后再决定购买。录制直播画面时，尽量把主播账号名称、直播间商品购买入口一并录进去，同时保证视频自带录制时间。消费者也可以向平台申请调取直播回放，但平台保存的回放经常缺失弹幕对话，自己录制的视频如果同时保留弹幕交流，证明力会更强。

消费维权案件里，不少消费者维权失败，就是因为证据链条不够完整，关键信息没能留存。

涂诗雨：订单截图、支付凭证、物流信息都要完整保存。收货环节尤其关键，贵重商品尽量录制完整开箱视频，全程不间断拍摄，清晰展示包裹外观、快递面单、商品实物、包装标签。一旦发现商品和宣传不符，不要丢弃商品外包装、防伪标识，这些都是后续鉴定、诉讼的重要物证。另外，和平台客服、商家沟通的聊天记录不要删除，涉及商品质量、赔付承诺的对话，都可以作为证据。

法官还特别提醒，尽量不要点击直播间跳转至微信、私域的外部链接下单。脱离平台监管的私下交易，后续举证、维权会更困难。

涂诗雨：发现权益受损，首先可以直接和商家协商和解。协商不成，在平台内提交售后申请，由平台介入调解。也可以拨打12315消费者投诉举报专线，向市场监管部门投诉举报。如果经调解仍无法解决纠纷，可依法向人民法院提起诉讼。如果商品存在假冒伪劣，还可以申请专业机构鉴定，鉴定产生的合理费用，在符合条件的情况下，可以主张由商家承担。 【编辑:蔡星雨】

关于印发新冠病毒疫苗第二剂次加强免疫接种实施方案的通知

各省、自治区、直辖市及新疆生产建设兵团应对新型冠状病毒肺炎疫情联防联控机制（领导小组、指挥部），国务院应对新型冠状病毒肺炎疫情联防联控机制疫苗接种工作协调组各成员单位：

现将《新冠病毒疫苗第二剂次加强免疫接种实施方案》印发给你们，请结合实际认真贯彻落实。

为深入贯彻落实党中央、国务院决策部署，进一步做好新冠肺炎疫情应对工作，保障人民群众生命安全和身体健康，经研究，现提出新冠病毒疫苗第二剂次加强免疫接种实施方案。

现阶段，可在第一剂次加强免疫接种基础上，在感染高风险人群、60岁以上老年人群、具有较严重基础性疾病人群和免疫力低下人群中开展第二剂次加强免疫接种。

（一）疫苗选择。根据疫苗研发工作进展，所有批准附条件上市或紧急使用的疫苗均可用于第二剂次加强免疫。优先考虑序贯加强免疫接种，或采用含奥密克戎毒株或对奥密克戎毒株具有良好交叉免疫的疫苗进行第二剂次加强免疫接种，有关组合如下：

3剂灭活疫苗+1剂康希诺肌注式重组新冠病毒疫苗（5型腺病毒载体）；

3剂灭活疫苗+1剂智飞龙科马重组新冠病毒疫苗（CHO细胞）；

3剂灭活疫苗+1剂康希诺吸入用重组新冠病毒疫苗（5型腺病毒载体）；

3剂灭活疫苗+1剂珠海丽珠重组新冠病毒融合蛋白（CHO细胞）疫苗；

2剂康希诺肌注式腺病毒载体疫苗+1剂康希诺吸入用重组新冠病毒疫苗（5型腺病毒载体）；

3剂灭活疫苗+1剂成都威斯克重组新冠病毒疫苗（sf9细胞）；

3剂灭活疫苗+1剂北京万泰鼻喷流感病毒载体新冠病毒疫苗；

3剂灭活疫苗+1剂浙江三叶草重组新冠病毒蛋白亚单位疫苗（CHO细胞）；

3剂灭活疫苗+1剂神州细胞重组新冠病毒2价S三聚体蛋白疫苗。

（二）时间间隔。根据国内外真实世界研究和临床试验数据，结合我国疫苗接种实际，第二剂次加强免疫与第一剂次加强免疫时间间隔为6个月以上。

各地要继续把接种安全放在首要位置，严格按照《预防接种工作规范》要求，规范组织接种实施。各地卫生健康部门要落实接种单位有二级以上综合医院急诊急救人员驻点保障、有急救设备药品、有120急救车现场值守、有二级以上综合医院救治绿色通道的“四有”要求，保障接种安全。接种单位要做好加强免疫的接种信息登记和疫苗流向管理，及时准确更新免疫规划信息系统和预防接种凭证中接种记录相关内容。

（一）强化属地主体责任。各地要落实属地管理责任，高度重视并统筹做好新冠病毒疫苗接种工作。要加强对辖区内疫苗接种工作的指导，全面掌握工作进展。地方各相关部门要加强对接，做好工作协同。

（二）落实部门行业管理责任。各相关行业主管部门要指导本行业人员所在单位积极配合地方统一安排，共同做好组织动员工作。

（三）加强监督指导。要密切跟踪监测各地第二剂次加强免疫接种进展，及时发现和研究解决相关问题。健全疫苗流向全程追溯体系，完善疫苗全链条安全监管机制，持续加强全流程管理和安全防范。

（四）做好宣传引导。各地和有关部门要根据工作需要，有针对性地制定第二剂次加强免疫接种工作的宣传措施，重点宣传加强免疫接种的目的意义，积极引导目标人群主动接种，特别要引导提升老年人群的接种率。

2026年11月11日，据北京市第一中级人民法院消息，该院依法公开宣判北京电影学院原副院长尼跃红犯受贿罪一案，对被告人尼跃红以受贿罪判处有期徒刑十年，并处罚金人民币五十万元；对被告人尼跃红受贿犯罪所得予以没收，上缴国库。

公开简历显示，尼跃红，男，汉族，1957年9月生于河北，现年已69岁。1974年12月参加工作，1977年12月加入中国共产党。

尼跃红1984年获中央工艺美术学院学士学位，1988年获同校硕士学位，2003年于清华大学美术学院获博士学位。曾任北京服装学院工艺美术系副主任、主任、院长助理、副院长等职务。2005年7月-2012年1月，尼跃红担任北京青年政治学院副院长、党委委员。

2012年起，尼跃红开始担任北京电影学院副院长。公开报道没有显示尼跃红是何时卸任这一职务，期间他曾兼任北京电影学院中国电影衍生产业研究院院长。2022年时，他在媒体报道中的身份已经变成南充电影工业职业学院院长。据媒体报道，近年来尼跃红仍较为频繁地出现在各类工艺美术活动中。

2025年10月28日，北京市纪委监委发布消息，北京电影学院原副院长尼跃红涉嫌严重违纪违法被查。

北京电影学院前身是1950年创建的表演艺术研究所，1953年更名为北京电影学校，1956年改为四年本科建制的北京电影学院。

艺术类院校近年腐败案频发，成为高校反腐的重点领域，此前已有沈阳音乐学院原党委书记董亲学、星海音乐学院原党委书记王秀明、中央美术学院设计学院原院长宋协伟、哈尔滨音乐学院原党委书记关健等人先后落马。2025年还有南京艺术学院原副院长谢建明、中央美术学院设计学院原副院长张欣荣、中央音乐学院作曲系原副主任常平等人被查。

心梗发作前，身体会发出哪些警报？(健康驿站·急症早识别)

立冬过后，气温走低，心血管急症风险随之升高。凶险的心梗，未必都是撕心裂肺的胸痛。哪些不适是容易被忽视的心梗警报？普通人该如何快速分辨小病还是心梗？本报记者就此采访了北京大学人民医院心血管内科主任医师刘健。

记者：什么是心梗？发作时有哪些表现？为什么必须立即抢救？

刘健：急性心肌梗死简称“急性心梗”或“心梗”，简单说，就是给心脏供血的冠状动脉突然堵了，或者严重变窄，导致一部分心肌长时间缺血、缺氧而坏死。最常见的情况是血管里的粥样硬化斑块破裂，随后引发血栓形成，把血管堵住或堵得更窄；少数也可由冠脉痉挛、栓塞、夹层等原因引起。

心梗发作时，患者通常会感到胸口压榨样疼痛或闷痛，这种痛感有时会放射到左臂、肩背或下颌，还可能伴有冷汗淋漓、恶心呕吐、呼吸不畅等表现。但部分患者可能没有典型胸痛，而表现为胸闷、气短、乏力、上腹不适或晕厥。

心梗可能导致恶性心律失常、心力衰竭、心源性休克甚至心脏骤停，因此属于需要立即抢救的危急病症。一旦怀疑心梗，应立即拨打急救电话，尽快开通堵塞的血管，切勿拖延，这是挽救生命的关键。

刘健：心梗的发生，通常是在冠状动脉粥样硬化等基础病变上，叠加危险因素和诱发因素的结果。冠状动脉粥样硬化是最重要的基础病因；吸烟、糖尿病、血脂异常、超重或肥胖、不健康饮食等是重要的危险因素；情绪激动、气温骤变、突然进行高强度运动、长期熬夜或过度劳累、短时间内大量进食高脂饮食、激烈争吵、便秘时用力屏气排便等，可能让心脏负担突然加重，诱发急性缺血。因此，对已有冠心病等基础病变的人，生活中要尽量避免这些诱因，控制危险因素。

记者：心梗在一天和一年中有哪些高发时段？日常应如何防范？

刘健：心梗存在比较明显的时段规律，清晨和寒冷季节相对高发。

清晨，人从睡眠状态醒来时，交感神经开始兴奋，血压上升、心率加快，血液中的血小板更容易聚集，抗凝能力相对下降。这些变化叠加在一起，会让原本不稳定的血管斑块更容易破裂，形成血栓。所以建议大家晨起时不要猛地起身，可以先在床上躺一会儿，活动活动手脚，再慢慢坐起来，坐一两分钟后再下床。

此外，寒冷季节心梗风险更高。低温和气温骤降会刺激血管收缩，使血压升高、心率加快，加重心脏负担，容易诱发心绞痛、心梗。一般来说，每年11月到次年3月是急性心肌梗死等心血管事件的高发期。但夏季也要注意，尤其是从高温室外突然进入低温空调房，冷热交替同样可能诱发心脏事件。建议冬天外出注意保暖，尤其护好头颈和胸口；夏季空调不要调得过低，室内外温差尽量控制在7摄氏度以内，进屋前可先缓一缓。已有高血压、冠心病的人还应规律服药，避免血压大幅波动。

记者：除典型的胸口压榨样疼痛外，心梗有哪些容易被忽视的不典型表现？哪些情况需高度警惕？

刘健：胸痛是急性心梗的重要症状，但并非所有心梗都会出现胸痛。不典型表现可包括下颌至腹部范围内的疼痛或不适，如牙疼、下颌痛、肩背痛、上腹痛、咽喉不适等；疼痛性质可为压迫感、紧缩感、烧灼感、压榨样不适、撕裂样疼痛、隐痛，甚至难以描述的不适。部分患者可伴出汗、心慌、气短、呼吸困难、虚脱或濒死感。这些表现容易被误认为胃病、牙病、肌肉劳损或普通疲劳，从而延误救治。

出现以下情况应高度警惕心梗：症状无法用原有疾病解释；同时伴有胸闷、气短、大汗、头晕或恶心；在体力活动或情绪激动时诱发或加重，休息后仅部分缓解；针对“疑似病因”的常规处理无效。老年人、女性和糖尿病患者症状更不典型，应更留意。任何突发、无法解释的身体不适，一旦怀疑心梗，应立即拨打120。

时间就是生命，心肌梗死救治的黄金时间窗是120分钟，早一分钟开通血管，就能多保住一些心肌细胞，预后越好。

记者：出现疼痛等不适时，普通人在家如何区分是普通胃病、肌肉劳损这样的小毛病，还是心梗这样的急症？

刘健：在家判断的关键不是精确认定疾病，而是快速识别“不像小毛病”的危险信号，可按以下三步判断：

第一步，按压和动作测试。能找到明确压痛点，按压更疼，或疼痛与抬手、转身、深呼吸等动作明确相关，休息或按摩热敷后缓解，更支持肌肉劳损；若按不到明确痛点，肢体动作不影响疼痛，按摩热敷无效，且为持续闷痛、压榨感，需警惕心脏问题。

第二步，看有无全身警报。若不适同时伴有突然冒冷汗、呼吸困难、头晕、眼前发黑、恶心、莫名恐惧或濒死感中的任一项，无论疼痛位于何处，在无法排除心梗时都应优先怀疑心脏，并立即拨打120。

第三步，看诱因和持续时间。普通胃病多与进食相关，有规律，调整饮食或服胃药后缓解；心脏信号常与体力活动或情绪激动有关，也可在安静时突发，与进食无关。若症状持续超过15分钟不缓解，或症状性质、程度与以往不同，常规处理无效，也应按心梗处理。

记者：心梗发作前数天甚至数周可能有哪些前驱表现？什么情况下需要尽快就医？

刘健：50%—80%的急性心肌梗死患者在发病前1—2天或更早可出现预警征兆，但多不特异，容易被当成劳累、感冒或“老胃病”。常见前驱表现包括：与活动量不匹配的极度疲劳，女性更突出，休息后也难以恢复；与进食无关、服胃药无效的上腹闷胀、烧灼感、恶心或消化不良，且可在活动或情绪激动时诱发或加重；胸部闷胀而非剧痛；放射至左肩、后背、下颌或咽喉却找不到具体痛点的疼痛；轻微活动即气短；莫名心慌、头晕、出冷汗。

莫名乏力或胃部不适是否需就医，可沿用前述危险信号，并特别注意：无明确诱因、休息或对症处理后不缓解，或服胃药无效；伴有前述全身警报中的任一项；在走路、上楼或情绪激动时出现或加重，休息几分钟后减轻；上腹不适或胸部闷胀持续超过15分钟不缓解。糖尿病患者可能因神经病变仅表现为乏力或恶心，需更警觉。

总之，当一种“小毛病”与以往经验不同、说不清原因时，宁可当作一次“虚惊”去排查，也不要当成“老毛病”硬扛。

记者：怀疑心梗时，网上流传不少急救方法，比如用力咳嗽或拍打胳膊肘自救、喝水，自行服用阿司匹林、含服硝酸甘油或速效救心丸。其中，哪些是误区、存在风险？用药有哪些重要的前提和禁忌？

刘健：怀疑心梗时，错误的处置可能比疾病本身更危险，任何自救动作，都不能替代立即拨打120和寻求专业医疗评估。

首先，用力咳嗽、拍打胳膊肘不能疏通血管，反而会增加心脏负担，可能加重病情甚至诱发心跳骤停；喝水会增加心脏泵血负担，意识不清时还可能导致误吸、窒息。以上这些做法均错误。

阿司匹林是抗血小板药物，核心作用是预防血栓，适合冠心病患者长期规律服用，不是应急药。在不确定病情的时候，不建议胸痛者服用阿司匹林，因为心梗并非引起胸痛的唯一原因。疑似主动脉夹层、活动性出血或近期脑出血、对阿司匹林过敏、正在使用其他抗凝药者，严禁服用阿司匹林，以免加重病情。如果既往有明确的冠心病史、意识清醒且能够吞咽、无禁忌，可在120调度或急救人员指导下嚼服300毫克阿司匹林(非肠溶片优先；如仅有肠溶片可嚼碎)。

硝酸甘油是冠心病、心绞痛患者的必备急救药物，它能快速扩张血管、暂时缓解心绞痛，但不能替代就医。疑似心梗时，不建议自行反复含服；如既往有冠心病心绞痛史、血压正常、无禁忌，可在急救人员指导下舌下含服；5分钟不缓解可重复1次，最多3次；若仍不缓解，应立即拨打120，不得因反复含服延误救治。禁忌包括：低血压、严重贫血、右心室梗死、正在服用西地那非或他达拉非等PDE-5抑制剂、严重心动过缓或心动过速、肥厚型梗阻性心肌病、闭角型青光眼、颅内压增高或脑出血、对硝酸甘油过敏。含服时应坐位或半卧位，避免站立摔倒或平躺加重心脏负担。

在怀疑心梗、手边没有硝酸甘油或存在硝酸甘油禁忌时，可以选择速效救心丸作为急救药，但它也不能替代就医。速效救心丸是由川芎、冰片等中药组成的中成药，能增加冠脉血流量，缓解心绞痛。它的禁忌人群包括：孕妇、哺乳期女性，对成分过敏者，低血压或休克者，有出血倾向或活动性出血者，正在服用抗凝、抗血小板药者等。如既往有冠心病心绞痛史、无禁忌，怀疑心梗时可舌下含服10至15粒，一般5分钟左右起效。如果用药10分钟后症状不缓解，可再含服1次，同时拨打120。

记者：急救送医时，要不要舍近求远去大医院？选择就诊医院优先看哪些条件？

刘健：心梗救治的核心是尽快开通堵塞血管。选择医院既要考虑距离，也要考虑救治能力。120调度会优先选择具有“胸痛中心”资质的医院，因其具备快速诊疗通道和心脏介入能力。若附近没有胸痛中心，应就近紧急处理(如溶栓)，再根据病情转运至有条件的医院。

记者：高度怀疑心梗时，第一时间正确处置流程是什么？拨打120时应重点告知哪些信息？

刘健：可概括为“停、呼、卧、等”，即停止活动、呼叫120、舒适静卧、等待专业救援和评估。只要所处位置安全，让患者就地平躺，或在有靠背处坐下，保持安静休息，不要扶起患者；立即拨打120，并重点告知准确地点、主要症状、意识状态、联系方式、既往病史和正在使用的药物。

切记，不要自行开车送医，因为途中可能发生心律失常、休克甚至猝死，救护车有专业人员和设备，更安全。到院后不要到门诊挂号候诊，应直接去急诊；胸痛中心会按流程开设绿色通道。入院后，应听从医生建议，配合检查和治疗，犹豫等待会加重病情。急诊冠脉介入手术尽快开通堵塞血管，才能尽可能保留心肌细胞和心脏功能。

记者：近些年，临床急诊中二三十岁的心梗患者并不罕见。为什么二三十岁的人也会发生心梗？

刘健：与老年人相比，年轻人的心梗大多是多种后天危险因素叠加的结果。

老年人心梗多为血管数十年逐步老化、动脉粥样硬化常年进展所致；而很多年轻人血管基础尚可，但多种不良生活习惯会加速血管内皮损伤。

首要危险因素是吸烟。临床研究显示，35岁及以下心梗患者中74%存在吸烟习惯。尼古丁可直接损伤血管内壁，加速斑块形成。

其次是长期熬夜、持续高压加班。熬夜可扰乱自主神经功能，使血压、心率长期波动，血管持续处于应激状态。此外，久坐不动也是重要因素：白天长时间伏案会减慢血液循环，若再叠加外卖高油、高盐、高糖饮食，高脂血症、高血压可能在不知不觉中发生，很多年轻人并不知道自己的血脂、血压已经超标。

另一个值得注意的诱因是突击式、透支式运动。平时久坐少动，却在周末或下班后疲惫状态下突然进行高强度锻炼，突然的高强度刺激可能成为心梗发作的导火索。

此外，不少年轻人忽视体检，认为“没有不舒服＝身体没问题”，但早期“三高”常没有明显症状，不筛查就难以发现。还有部分人存在先天性隐匿性心脏结构问题，平时毫无察觉。

刘健：定期体检筛查，早发现隐患。即使自我感觉健康，每年也应完成至少一次全身体检，重点关注血压、血糖、血脂及体重指标。40岁以上人群，或具备心脑血管病家族史、“三高”、吸烟、肥胖等危险因素者，建议在医生指导下增加心脏专项检查，以便及早发现隐匿病变。

严控“三高”因素，早干预风险。预防远比补救更重要。所有人应严格控制血压、血糖、血脂与体重，保持均衡饮食、戒烟限酒、充足睡眠和规律运动，并建立健康减压方式。确诊“三高”及心血管病者遵医嘱用药，记录好静息心率、血压等指标，当出现持续且无法解释的轻微不适时，可比对基线数据并及时咨询医生。

制订急救计划，做好准备以应对险情。将急救电话、附近设有胸痛中心的医院联系方式及紧急联系人电话，保存在手机快捷菜单或易取位置，以备急需。同时，心梗高危人群应主动告知家人自身情况，并与家人共同了解心梗的典型和非典型症状，在医生指导下备好硝酸甘油等急救药物；一旦出现异常，及时呼叫救援，争取宝贵救治时间。

The published evidence regarding VLCD before cholecystectomy in obese patients is limited. After acknowledging the limitations of the data, VLCD is associated with a significantly higher rate of weight loss preoperatively and directly impacts the ease of intraoperative dissection of Calot’s triangle. Routine use of VLCD should be considered for all obese patients undergoing elective LC.

There is an increasing global prevalence of obesity.[1] In England, 26% of adults are obese.[2] Obesity increases the complexity of surgical intervention, can increase operative time and can be associated with worse outcomes.[3-5]

Laparoscopic cholecystectomy (LC) is one of the most frequently performed surgical procedures worldwide.[6] Given that obesity is a well-recognised risk factor for gallstone disease, it is common to perform LC on overweight and obese patients.[3] In the UK, over 40% of patients undergoing cholecystectomy have a body mass index (BMI) of 30 kg/m2 and above.[7]

Obesity can increase the technical difficulty of any laparoscopic procedure – the increased abdominal wall adiposity can make access to the abdominal cavity challenging and provide resistance to port movement.[8] With regard to LC, as a consequence of the metabolic syndrome of obesity, the liver becomes steatotic and enlarged.[4] A combination of an enlarged, rigid, left hemi-liver can make a fundal retraction and subsequent visualisation of the structures in Calot’s triangle challenging.[5,8] A failure to expose Calot’s triangle and the subsequent acquisition of the critical view of safety is an acknowledged risk factor for bile duct injury.[9] Obesity may also result in increased rates of bleeding from the liver as a consequence of the friable nature of a steatotic liver.[10]

Risk mitigation strategies for obese patients have become an important area of research focus. Emerging evidence from within the wider medical literature has demonstrated that a pre-operative very low-calorie diet (VLCD) is associated with improved surgical outcomes for obese patients when undergoing bariatric and other upper gastrointestinal surgery.[11] VLCD induces the mobilisation of liver glycogen stores and alters metabolic pathways in vivo.[12,13] This results in a quantifiable reduction in liver size and volume.[10] As a consequence, this enables improved visualisation of key anatomical landmarks and reduces complication rates.[14] Although widely used, the role of VLCD before LC in obese patients is unclear. The aim of this systematic review and meta-analysis was to evaluate whether routine use of VLCD should be considered for all obese patients undergoing LC.

This systematic review and meta-analysis was performed with adherence to the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guidance.[15] A study protocol was prospectively registered on PROSPERO (CRD42022374610).

A systematic search through the pre-existing medical literature was performed regarding VLCD before cholecystectomy. The search was performed on four online literature databases (PubMed, Embase, Medline and Cochrane Library archives). A specific search criterion was created and adjusted for each data archive. Medical Subject Headings and keywords were used for the purpose of the search. The search contained the following specific terminology: low calorie diet, liver shrinkage diet, very low energy diet, preoperative, pre-op and cholecystectomy. Boolean operators ‘AND’ and ‘OR’ were incorporated into the search to capture a comprehensive overview of the published literature. The grey literature was hand searched in addition to the reference lists of the included and excluded literature to identify additional relevant studies. Studies that were non-English articles, non-full text or conference abstracts were excluded.

All studies were compared to the pre-defined inclusion and exclusion criteria by independent screening by two authors (DH and ME). Following an abstract screen, a full-text screen was subsequently performed, and if the article was deemed appropriate, it was subsequently included in the study. Any data collection discrepancies were resolved by a consensus discussion. The following data were collected from all studies: study design and methodology, nature of dietary intervention, patient demographics and pre-defined outcomes (weight loss, operative time, ease of surgery/dissection/exposure of Calot’s triangle). All included articles were assessed for risk of bias and methodological quality by using the Cochrane Collaboration’s tool.[16]

The primary outcome measure of this meta-analysis was determining the impact of pre-operative VLCD on the operative findings and dissection during LC in obese patients, specifically the reported ease of Calot’s triangle dissection. The secondary outcome measures were pre-operative weight loss, operative time and the effect of VLCD on liver steatosis. The reported mean difficulty score for Calot’s dissection was collected and used in the quantitative meta-analysis. For articles that did not report the mean score, the mean value was estimated from the reported median value using the described method by Wan et al.[17] If articles used opposite ordinal grading of intraoperative difficulty, online digitizer software was used to generate digital images of graphs before obtaining absolute patient numbers per reporting metric of difficulty to establish a consistent semi-qualitative scale. Review Manager (RevMan, version 5.4) platform and R Foundation Statistical software (R 3.6.3) were used to perform statistical analysis. A random-effects model was performed, and results were visualised through forest plots. I2 values were calculated to assess for heterogeneity amongst studies. An I2 value of >75% was deemed to be a high degree of heterogeneity, whereas an I2 value of 25%–57% and <25% was deemed moderate and low degrees of heterogeneity, respectively. Results were deemed to be of statistical significance when P < 0.05. An assessment of publication bias through funnel plot was not feasible as <10 articles were used within the meta-analysis.[18]

Following a systematic search through the literature, a total of 77 papers were found. After screening against the pre-defined inclusion and exclusion criteria, only two articles were included in the systematic review and meta-analysis.[19,20]Figure 1 illustrates the PRISMA flow chart of the literature search. Both included studies were single-centre studies, conducted within the United Kingdom. The study design and characteristics are highlighted in Table 1. It should be highlighted that the patient inclusion criteria did differ between both studies, Burnand et al. included patients with a BMI >30 with symptomatic gallstones, whereas Jones et al. did not use a pre-defined BMI cut-off and only included patients with symptomatic gallstones.[19,20] Both studies utilised VLCD preoperatively; the VLCD described was a diet consisting of a calorific intake of 800 Kcal/day for 2 weeks before surgery.

Characteristics of included studies

Both included studies had a small overall number of patients included.[19,20] The demographics of the patients are highlighted in Table 2. Both studies had a female predominance in the patient population, with a median age ranging between 43.5 and 48 years of age. The median BMI reported did differ between both studies. Burnand et al. reported a median BMI of 33.6 and 34 in the control and VCLD cohorts, respectively.[19] However, a much lower median BMI (30.2) was reported overall by Jones et al.[20]

The reporting of outcomes differed between studies [Table 3]. Burnand et al. published results on quantifiable timing metrics of both surgery and time to discharge, in addition to ease of dissection. They reported that within the VLCD cohort, the median operative time was less (25 vs. 31 min) and the median length of stay post-procedure was shorter (8 vs. 10 h) when compared to the control cohort.[19] They also reported on intraoperative assessment of ease of Calot’s dissection, fundal retraction and liver displacement. While all three of the aforementioned surgical steps of LC were reported as easier within the VLCD cohort, only Calot’s dissection was statistically significant (P = 0.02). Jones et al. only reported intraoperative subjective assessment of perceived difficulty of dissection of Calot’s triangle, gall bladder bed dissection, degree of liver steatosis and overall technical difficulty.[20] They reported on three different cohorts of patients: overall VLCD-compliant and non-compliant patients, obese and non-obese patients and, finally, VLCD-compliant and non-compliant obese patients. Within the final cohort, they noted that both visualisation of Calot’s triangle and gall bladder bed dissection were much easier within the VLCD-compliant obese cohort, although not statistically significant (P > 0.05).[20]

A meta-analysis of reported outcomes for ease of Calot’s dissection was performed [Table 4]. For all patients included in both studies, there was no statistical improvement in the ease of Calot’s dissection with pre-operative VLCD (P = 0.21) [Table 4]. A moderate degree of heterogeneity was observed amongst studies (I2 of 48%). A subsequent subgroup analysis was performed, only using the obese patients from the Jones et al.’s study.[20] In the obese patient cohort, pre-operative VLCD before cholecystectomy significantly improved the ease of Calot’s dissection (P = 0.01). A low degree of heterogeneity was noted in this analysis (I2 of 0%). A meta-analysis of pre-operative weight loss was performed. VLCD before cholecystectomy was associated with significantly higher pre-operative weight loss when compared to normal diet/standard of care alone (P < 0.01) with low heterogeneity across studies (I2 of 3%).

Meta-analysis of primary and secondary outcomes

The obesity pandemic remains an ongoing health crisis that displays no evidence of a plateau in incidence. Obesity converts patients with uncomplicated diseases into high-risk patients both from an anaesthetic and surgical perspective.[21] Weight loss optimisation serves as a crucial intervention to manage an individual’s risk.[22]

The literature regarding VLCD before bariatric surgery displays a clear benefit.[14] Van Nieuwenhove et al. presented a multicentre randomised study of pre-operative VLCD before laparoscopic gastric bypass.[14] They demonstrated that there was an observed benefit both intraoperatively and postoperatively, with a reduced complication rate, with VLCD.[14] While evaluating the advantage of VLCD, studies should also report on complication rates. Complication rates serves as an important outcome measure and studies should not solely focus on operative time metrics (e.g., duration of surgery) for the purpose of their outcome analysis. While VLCD is frequently used before LC, the perceived benefit is often extrapolated from the wider literature, which is predominantly composed of studies looking at its use before reflux or bariatric surgery. Only two studies were identified specifically looking at its use before LC. This was the rationale for performing this meta-analysis to evaluate the evidence for VLCD before LC in obese patients.

Of the two included articles, only one of which recorded complication rates.[19] Burnand et al. revealed no significant. Burnand et al. revealed no significant difference in complication rates between both cohorts.[19] However, they did not report or comment on bile duct injury. Given the low incidence rate of bile duct injury in general, using this as a sole outcome measure would be inappropriate; in addition, future prospective studies would require an exceptionally large number of patients to demonstrate a reduction in bile duct injury rates with VLCD. An alternative approach would be assessing complications in general and cholecystectomy-specific complications (bile duct injury and bile leak) as a hybrid outcome measure.

VLCD induces several metabolic alterations that improve the resting physiology of both the cardiovascular and endocrine systems. What is yet to be determined is the optimal time frame duration for VLCD before surgery. Both articles in this systematic review and meta-analysis utilised 2 weeks of VLCD. Norén and Forssell evaluated the impact of 4 weeks of VLCD on metabolic health.[23] They demonstrated that with the extended diet timeframe, the fasting glucose, HbA1c, cholesterol and triglyceride serum levels all improved.[23] It is likely that a prolonged diet will produce more drastic results. However, there is a delicate equilibrium between the duration of VLCD and patient adherence to the diet. As illustrated in both included papers, patient adherence to strict VLCD varied. Failure to complete the full 2-week diet course would render the intervention purposeless. As such, patient compliance is essential. An interesting systematic review published by Romeijn et al. assessed different LCDs before bariatric surgery.[10] They reviewed both VLCD and LCD, where an LCD consisted of a daily calorific intake of 800–1200 kcal.[10] They concluded that pursuing an LCD for 2–4 weeks produced the optimal results. Through using a less intensive diet, this, in turn, may improve patient compliance rates.

An important effect of VLCD that is not reported in either study is its effect on liver volume. There is evolving evidence to suggest that VLCD induces a reduction in liver size.[24] González-Pérez et al. demonstrated that a VLCD can result in a detectable reduction in liver volumetry based on cross-sectional imaging.[25] While not directly addressed in either study, the reduction in liver volume may be the underlying mechanism that facilitates better exposure and subsequent dissection of Calot’s triangle.

As a sequela to the COVID pandemic, an increasing number of patients with delayed complex gallstone disease are being seen by acute surgical teams. The meta-analysis of the results from within this study would suggest that there is evidence for VLCD in the elective setting. One aspect that remains unclear is how does this translate to the acute setting, especially in the context of obese patients presenting with acute biliary pathology. Further research is required to determine whether obese patients in the acute setting would benefit from conservative management in the first instance, followed by an elective cooling period accompanied by VLCD to have a ‘cold’ cholecystectomy with improved exposure to Calot’s anatomy. This should serve as a research focus for future studies.

There are limitations to note within this systematic review and meta-analysis. The total number of included articles is limited. In addition, within these articles, there are also a relatively small number of patients included. Consequently, the overall patient population available for meta-analysis is relatively small, and this may subsequently impact the statistical validity and the power of the analysis. While it would be desirable to have multiple studies to include in the analysis, the systematic search of the literature identified a lack of published data on the topic. A meta-analysis of the results was pursued, given the low heterogeneity (I2 of <3%) of the desired patient population across both studies.[26] Both included studies are single institutional studies with subjective outcome measures, which raises the question of reproducibility in a multi-centre context. The reporting of outcome measures differed between studies and as such limited our ability to conduct multiple meta-analyses of outcomes of interest. No benefit to VLCD was observed in the entire patient cohort with regard to Calot’s dissection; however, this result was likely skewed because the study by Jones et al. included non-obese patients. Upon subgroup analysis on obese patients alone, a benefit was noted with easier Calot’s dissection. Neither study formally quantified liver volumetry following VLCD. Patient adherence to diet also varied, thus impacting the results.

The current medical literature regarding VLCD before LC is limited. The evidence is based on small single-centre studies alone. After acknowledging the limitations of the data, this meta-analysis would suggest that VLCD should be used routinely preoperatively for obese patients undergoing elective cholecystectomy. VLCD is a non-invasive, affordable and effective intervention that promotes pre-operative weight loss and reduction in liver volume and may help with intraoperative dissection of Calot’s triangle. Further research should focus on addressing the optimal time window for VCLD preoperatively combined with the degree of calorific restriction in both a prospective and multi-centre setting.
